qe: To which ecological nutritional categories do standard biological decomposers like fungi and bacteria simultaneously belong?
qh: कवक (fungi) और बैक्टीरिया जैसे अपघटक (decomposers) एक साथ किन पोषण श्रेणियों के अंतर्गत आते हैं?
oe: Autotrophs and photo-autotrophs
Heterotrophs and saprotrophs
Chemo-autotrophs and herbivores
Omnivores and primary producer grids
oh: स्वपोषी और प्रकाश-स्वपोषी
परपोषी एवं मृतोपजीवी
रसायन-स्वपोषी और शाकाहारी
सर्वाहारी और प्राथमिक उत्पादक ग्रिड
e:
Ecological nutritional framework me organisms ko unke carbon source aur energy acquisition mechanism ke basis par classify kiya jata hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because fungi aur standard decomposer bacteria me chlorophyll arrays nahi hote, isliye ye autotrophs ya photo-autotrophs nahi ho sakte.

• Option 2 is Correct because fungi aur bacteria apna organic food khud synthesize nahi kar sakte, jo inhe heterotrophs banata hai; sath hi ye dead organic matter par extracellular enzymes secrete karke soluble nutrients absorb karte hain, isliye inhe saprotrophs ke roop me categorize kiya jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because chemo-autotrophs inorganic chemical oxidation se energy banate hain aur herbivores living plant biomass consume karte hain, jabki decomposers saprotrophic nature show karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because decomposers organic food synthesize nahi karte (non-producers) aur na hi ye whole plant/animal tissues ko ingest karte hain.

qe: What precise ecological change characterizes the step known as mineralization during the systematic decomposition of detritus?
qh: अपघटन (decomposition) की प्रक्रिया के दौरान 'खनिजीकरण' (mineralization) चरण की क्या विशेषता है?
oe: The complete conversion of simple minerals into volatile synthetic gases
The systematic release of inorganic nutrients from the complex organic humus layer
The fast free-radical addition polymer cross-linking of cellulose fibers
The immediate common-ion precipitation of all vital topsoil lipids
oh: सरल खनिजों का वाष्पशील सिंथेटिक गैसों में पूर्ण रूपांतरण
जटिल कार्बनिक ह्यूमस परत से अकार्बनिक पोषक तत्वों का व्यवस्थित निष्कासन
सेल्यूलोज फाइबर का तीव्र मुक्त-रेडिकल जोड़ बहुलक क्रॉस-लिंकिंग
सभी महत्वपूर्ण ऊपरी मिट्टी के लिपिड का तत्काल सामान्य-आयन अवक्षेपण
e:
Decomposition process complex organic detritus ko step-by-step simple inorganic substances me break down karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because mineralization me synthetic gases form nahi hoti balki inorganic mineral ions soil solution me release hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because mineralization decomposition ka terminal phase hai, jahan microbes humus ko enzymatically degrade karke simple water-soluble inorganic nutrients jaise $	ext{K}^+$, $	ext{Mg}^{2+}$, $	ext{Ca}^{2+}$, $	ext{CO}_2$, aur $	ext{H}_2	ext{O}$ soil matrix me release karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because polymer cross-linking synthetic chemistry ka aspect hai, organic decomposition ka nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because soil lipids ka precipitation mineralization process ko define nahi karta.

qe: Which unique parameter dimension pairings express the quantitative value of primary or secondary productivity in an ecosystem?
qh: पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में प्राथमिक या द्वितीयक उत्पादकता (productivity) के मात्रात्मक मान को व्यक्त करने वाले विशिष्ट इकाइयाँ कौन सी हैं?
oe: $	ext{g}^{-1}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ and $	ext{kcal m}^{-3}$
$	ext{g m}^{-2}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ and $(	ext{kcal m}^{-2})	ext{ yr}^{-1}$
$	ext{g m}^{-3}$ and $	ext{kcal }^{-2}$
$	ext{kg}^{-1}	ext{ m}^{-3}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ alternative index
oh: $	ext{g}^{-1}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ और $	ext{kcal m}^{-3}$
$	ext{g m}^{-2}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ और $(	ext{kcal m}^{-2})	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ (द्रव्यमान या ऊर्जा प्रति इकाई क्षेत्र प्रति वर्ष)
$	ext{g m}^{-3}$ और $	ext{kcal }^{-2}$
$	ext{kg}^{-1}	ext{ m}^{-3}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$ वैकल्पिक सूचकांक
e:
Ecosystem productivity kisi given area me time ke sath biomass accumulation ya solar energy conversion ki quantitative rate ko represent karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because mass metric $	ext{g}^{-1}$ area aur mass dimension ko correctly express nahi karta aur volumetric energy $	ext{kcal m}^{-3}$ rate dimension missing rakhta hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because ecological productivity ko standardly biomass accumulation per unit area per unit time ($	ext{g m}^{-2}	ext{ yr}^{-1}$) ya energy fixed per unit area per unit time ($(	ext{kcal m}^{-2})	ext{ yr}^{-1}$) me measure kiya jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because isme time period component ($	ext{yr}^{-1}$) absent hai, jo rate define karne ke liye essential hota hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because volumetric rate metric general ecological surface calculations ke standard standard units ke conform nahi karta.

qe: In which specific macro ecosystem category is a molecular ecologist highly likely to chart an inverted pyramid of biomass?
qh: एक आणविक पारिस्थितिकीविद् द्वारा किस विशिष्ट पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (ecosystem) में जैवभार का उलटा पिरामिड (inverted pyramid of biomass) दर्ज करने की अत्यधिक संभावना है?
oe: Terrestrial tropical rain forest biome
Marine or aquatic ecosystem
Temperate grassland infrastructure
Arid desert landscape segments
oh: स्थलीय उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन बायोम
समुद्री या जलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र
शीतोष्ण घास का मैदान बुनियादी ढांचा
शुष्क मरुस्थलीय परिदृश्य खंड
e:
Biomass pyramids specific trophic levels par present standing crop biomass ke relative weight ko map karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because tropical rain forests me giant autotrophic trees ka biomass primary consumers se vastly superior hota hai, jisse pyramid upright banta hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because open marine ya aquatic ecosystems me microscopic primary producers (phytoplankton) ka standing crop biomass bohot kam hota hai, jabki large fishes aur secondary/tertiary consumers ka long lifespan aur accumulated mass zyada hota hai, resulting in an inverted pyramid of biomass.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because temperate grasslands me grasses ka collective biomass herbivores se zyada hone ke karan pyramid upright rehta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because terrestrial desert systems me primary producers ka aggregate dry weight higher trophic tiers se zyada rehta hai.

qe: Which structural biological organism is classified as a heterotrophic saprotroph, failing to act as a primary producer?
qh: कौन सा जैविक जीव एक परपोषी मृतोपजीवी (heterotrophic saprotroph) के रूप में वर्गीकृत है, जो प्राथमिक उत्पादक के रूप में कार्य करने में विफल रहता है?
oe: Spirogyra green algae chain
Agaricus mushroom basidiomycete
Volvox colonial autotroph
Nostoc cyanobacterial filament
oh: स्पाइरोगाइरा हरी शैवाल श्रृंखला
अगरिकस मशरूम बेसिडिओमाइसेट्स
वॉल्वॉक्स औपनिवेशिक स्वपोषी
नॉस्टॉक सायनोबैक्टीरियल फिलामेंट
e:
Primary producers light capture karke photo-autotrophic carbon fixation karte hain, jabki non-photosynthetic organisms heterotrophic modes par depend karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Spirogyra ek filamentous green alga hai jisme chloroplasts present hote hain aur ye autotrophic producer hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Agaricus ek basidiomycete fungus (mushroom) hai jisme chlorophyll completely absent hota hai; ye carbon fix nahi kar sakta aur nutrition ke liye dead organic humus par dependent saprotrophic heterotroph hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Volvox ek photosynthetic colonial green alga hai jo aquatic systems me producer ki tarah act karta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Nostoc nitrogen-fixing autotrophic cyanobacterium hai.

qe: Which global terrestrial ecosystem registers the highest net primary productivity metrics per unit area annually?
qh: कौन सा वैश्विक स्थलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (terrestrial ecosystem) प्रति वर्ष प्रति इकाई क्षेत्र में उच्चतम शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता दर्ज करता है?
oe: Subterranean hot arid deserts
Tropical rain forests
Open deep ocean floor grids
Temperate estuarine mud flats
oh: भूमिगत गर्म शुष्क मरुस्थल
उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन
खुले गहरे समुद्र तल ग्रिड
शीतोष्ण मुहाना कीचड़दार तट
e:
Net Primary Productivity (NPP) total photosynthetic yield me se autotrophic respiration ($R$) ko subtract karne ke baad bacha biomass hota hai: $	ext{NPP} = 	ext{GPP} - R$.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because hot arid deserts moisture deficit aur sparse plant density ke karan lowest terrestrial NPP show karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because tropical rain forests high moisture, continuous solar radiation, aur consistently warm temperatures receive karte hain, jo optimal enzymatic conditions maintain karke maximum annual NPP per unit area produce karti hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because open deep ocean terrestrial biome nahi hai aur nutrient limitation ke karan iski unit area productivity moderate-to-low hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because estuarine flats highly productive aquatic interfaces hote hain, par peak terrestrial metric tropical rain forests hold karte hain.

qe: What structural variation profile describes the geometric shape options achieved across ecological pyramids of numbers?
qh: संख्याओं के पारिस्थितिक पिरामिड (pyramids of numbers) के संबंध में कौन सा विन्यास सही है?
oe: They are restricted to being always upright
They can be either upright or inverted depending on structural community layouts
They are globally locked into an inverted geometric form
They degrade completely into an irregular unaligned grid format
oh: वे हमेशा सीधे होने के लिए बाध्य हैं
वे संरचनात्मक समुदाय लेआउट के आधार पर सीधे या उल्टे दोनों हो सकते हैं
वे वैश्विक स्तर पर उल्टे ज्यामितीय रूप में बंद हैं
वे पूरी तरह से एक अनियमित गैर-संरेखित ग्रिड प्रारूप में बदल जाते हैं
e:
Pyramid of numbers individual trophic levels par present individual organisms ke absolute numerical counts ko correlate karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because pyramid of numbers har system me upright nahi rehta; parasitism aur tree systems iska exception create karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because grasslands me abundant primary grass producers hone se pyramid upright hota hai, jabki ek single large tree ecosystem (jahan hazaaron insects ek single tree par feed karte hain) ya parasitic chains me numbers ka pyramid completely inverted ho jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because general grasslands aur aquatic food chains upright number profiles manifest karti hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because trophic pyramids clearly defined ecological tiers follow karte hain.

qe: What precise percentage range of total incident solar energy falling on plant leaves is successfully fixed into stored chemical energy via photosynthesis?
qh: पौधों की पत्तियों पर गिरने वाली कुल आपतित सौर ऊर्जा का कितना सटीक प्रतिशत प्रकाश संश्लेषण के माध्यम से संग्रहीत रासायनिक ऊर्जा में सफलतापूर्वक स्थिर होता है?
oe: Less than 0.1 percent threshold
2-10 percent of incident radiation
Exactly 30 percent balanced capture
Greater than 50 percent total PAR limits
oh: 0.1 प्रतिशत से कम सीमा
आपतित विकिरण का 2-10 प्रतिशत
सटीक 30 प्रतिशत संतुलित प्रग्रहण
कुल PAR सीमा के 50 प्रतिशत से अधिक
e:
Solar energy capture plant biological systems me thermodynamic limits aur photosynthetic pigment absorption spectrum par depend karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because actual conversion scale 0.1% se significantly higher operate karti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because total incident solar radiation me se less than 50% Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) hota hai; plants active PAR ka lagbhag 2-10% (jo total incident radiation ka lagbhag 1-5% banta hai) photosynthesis ke zariye organic chemical biomass me convert karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 30% conversion efficiency physiological photoinhibition aur thermal energy losses ke karan achieve nahi ho sakti.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because PAR capture limits 50% se kafi low hoti hain.

qe: In which environmental biome will the cellular decomposition of organic detritus proceed at the fastest kinetic rate?
qh: किस पर्यावरणीय बायोम (biome) में कार्बनिक अपशिष्ट का कोशिकीय अपघटन सबसे तीव्र गति से आगे बढ़ेगा?
oe: Tropical rain forest
Antarctic frozen ice shelf
Dry arid desert ecosystem
Alpine high altitude zone
oh: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन
अंटार्कटिक जमे हुए बर्फ की शेल्फ
शुष्क मरुस्थलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र
अल्पाइन उच्च ऊंचाई क्षेत्र
e:
Decomposition rate microflora enzyme kinetics, temperature, moisture, aur detritus chemical composition dwara govern hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because tropical rain forests high ambient temperature aur abundant rainfall provide karte hain, jo soil saprotrophic bacteria aur fungi ki enzymatic activity ko maximize karke decomposition kinetics ko fastest banata hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because freezing sub-zero conditions microbial enzymes ko inactivate kar deti hain, jisse decomposition process halt ho jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because moisture ki severe deficiency microbial growth aur enzymatic hydrolysis ko restrict karti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because continuous low temperatures alpine zones me detrital breakdown ko decelerate kar deti hain.

qe: According to Lindeman's ecological efficiency laws, what percentage of primary producer energy is standardly utilized to compile the biomass of the next trophic level?
qh: पारिस्थितिक दक्षता नियमों के अनुसार, एक ट्रॉफिक स्तर से अगले ट्रॉफिक स्तर तक कितनी प्रतिशत ऊर्जा स्थानांतरित होती है?
oe: 1 percent limit
10 percent
40 percent conversion index
90 percent metabolic waste fraction
oh: 1 प्रतिशत सीमा
10 प्रतिशत (10 प्रतिशत ऊर्जा का प्रवाह)
40 प्रतिशत रूपांतरण सूचकांक
90 प्रतिशत चयापचय अपशिष्ट अंश
e:
Raymond Lindeman (1942) ne trophic dynamics me energy flow efficiency ka ten percent law formulate kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 1% metric generally sunlight se primary producer initial capture efficiency par apply hota hai, consecutive trophic transfer par nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because Lindeman's 10% law ke mutabiq kisi ek trophic level me enter hone wali total energy ka average keval 10% hi agle trophic tier ke living biomass ke roop me assimilate ho pata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because higher metabolic maintenance expenditure ke karan 40% trophic conversion biologically unattainable hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 90% energy respiration aur metabolic heat dissipation ke roop me environment me dissipate ho jati hai, transfer nahi hoti.

qe: What operational descriptors map the structural transitions of biological communities during the process of ecological succession?
qh: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रमण (ecological succession) की प्रक्रिया के दौरान जैविक समुदायों के संरचनात्मक परिवर्तनों को कौन से विवरण स्पष्ट करते हैं?
oe: Orderly, predictable, and sequential community updates over time
Completely random and stochastic structural sorting steps
Instantaneous shifts that bypass local physical inputs
Unregulated fluctuations insulated from ambient climate factors
oh: समय के साथ व्यवस्थित, पूर्वानुमेय और अनुक्रमिक सामुदायिक परिवर्तन
पूरी तरह से यादृच्छिक और स्टोकेस्टिक संरचनात्मक छँटाई चरण
तात्कालिक बदलाव जो स्थानीय भौतिक इनपुट को दरकिनार करते हैं
परिवेशीय जलवायु कारकों से अप्रभावित अनियमित उतार-चढ़ाव
e:
Ecological succession environmental factors aur biotic communities ke mutual feedback dwara driven directional process hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because ecological succession kisi specific area me species composition me hone wala gradual, orderly, predictable aur sequential transition hai, jo changing abiotic parameters ke parallel move karta hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because succession random steps follow nahi karta balki defined seral stages me proceed karta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because community transformation instantaneous nahi balki decade-to-century scale par gradual biological evolution hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because successional patterns regional macro-climate ke sath coupled aur strictly regulated hote hain.

qe: What system status captures the operational condition of a stable climax community at the terminus of ecological succession?
qh: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रमण के अंत में एक स्थिर चरम समुदाय (climax community) की परिचालन स्थिति क्या होती है?
oe: A permanent state of non-equilibrium and flux
Near perfect harmony and dynamic equilibrium with the local environment
A chaotic array showing zero niche specialization traits
Rapid continuous composition modifications tracking daily heat
oh: गैर-संतुलन और निरंतर प्रवाह की एक स्थायी स्थिति
स्थानीय पर्यावरण के साथ गतिशील संतुलन और सामंजस्य की स्थिति
शून्य आला (niche) विशेषज्ञता लक्षणों को प्रदर्शित करने वाली एक अराजक व्यवस्था
दैनिक गर्मी को ट्रैक करने वाले तीव्र निरंतर संरचना संशोधन
e:
Climax community biotic succession ka terminal equilibrium state represent karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because climax stage unstable non-equilibrium me nahi balki high compositional stability me exist karti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because climax community native regional climate ke sath stable dynamic equilibrium achieve karti hai, jisme maximum biodiversity, complex food web networks, aur stable biomass content paya jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because climax communities advanced vertical stratification aur deep niche specialization show karti hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because daily microclimate flux ke response me climax species composition drastically change nahi hoti.

qe: Which nutrient biogeochemical cycle does not experience gaseous mass losses back into the atmosphere due to cellular respiration loops?
qh: कौन सा जैव-भू-रासायनिक चक्र (biogeochemical cycle) कोशिकीय श्वसन के कारण वायुमंडल में गैसीय द्रव्यमान की हानि का अनुभव नहीं करता है?
oe: Phosphorus cycle exclusively
Nitrogen pathway metrics
Sulphur sedimentary matrix lines
All of the above sedimentary/non-carbon cycles
oh: विशेष रूप से फास्फोरस चक्र
नाइट्रोजन मार्ग मेट्रिक्स
सल्फर अवसादी मैट्रिक्स रेखाएं
उपरोक्त सभी अवसादी/गैर-कार्बन चक्र
e:
Biogeochemical cycles me respiratory gaseous dissipation primarily carbon compounds par targetted hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect as an exclusive answer because phosphorus cycle respiratory losses show nahi karta, par nitrogen aur sulfur bhi respiratory gas exchange me release nahi hote.

• Option 2 is Incorrect as an exclusive answer because nitrogen biological denitrification se gaseous banta hai, cellular respiration loops se nahi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect as an exclusive answer because sulfur lithospheric cycling follow karta hai aur respiration se atmosphere me diffuse nahi hota.

• Option 4 is Correct because cellular respiration me specifically carbon ($	ext{CO}_2$) aur oxygen ($	ext{O}_2$) pathways direct respiratory gas exchange perform karte hain; sedimentary cycles (phosphorus, sulfur) aur nitrogen cycles respiratory metabolism se direct gaseous dissipation route experience nahi karte.

qe: What correct sequence outlines the progressive layout stages of primary community succession inside an aquatic hydrarch ecosystem?
qh: एक जलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (aquatic hydrarch ecosystem) के भीतर प्राथमिक अनुक्रमण के प्रगतिशील चरणों का सही क्रम क्या है?
oe: Phytoplankton, sedges, floating forms, rooted submerged forms, grasses, and trees
Phytoplankton, rooted submerged plants, floating hydrophytes, reed swamp, sedges, meadow, and trees
Free-floating forms, sedges, phytoplankton, rooted entries, and forest layers
Woodland trees, sedges, meadow blocks, and initial single plankton rings
oh: पादपप्लवक, सेज, तैरते रूप, जड़ वाले जलमग्न रूप, घास और पेड़
पादपप्लवक, जड़ वाले जलमग्न पौधे, तैरते हुए हाइड्रोफाइट्स, नरकुल दलदल, सेज, घास का मैदान और पेड़
मुक्त-तैरने वाले रूप, सेज, पादपप्लवक, जड़ वाली प्रविष्टियाँ और वन परतें
वुडलैंड के पेड़, सेज, घास के मैदान के ब्लॉक और प्रारंभिक एकल प्लवक के छल्ले
e:
Hydrarch succession standing open water bodies se shuru hokar mature mesic forest conditions ki taraf systematically progress karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because rooted submerged plants floating forms se pehle aate hain aur sedge stage swamp ke baad develop hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because hydrosere ka accurate ecological sequence hai: Phytoplankton (pioneer stage) $ightarrow$ Rooted submerged hydrophytes $ightarrow$ Floating-leaved hydrophytes $ightarrow$ Reed-swamp stage $ightarrow$ Sedge-meadow stage $ightarrow$ Woodland stage $ightarrow$ Climax forest trees.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because phytoplankton pioneers hote hain, free-floating macrophytes unke baad aate hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because woodland climax community hoti hai, pioneer nahi.

qe: Where does the baseline reservoir pool for gaseous-type biogeochemical nutrient cycles like carbon and nitrogen reside?
qh: कार्बन और नाइट्रोजन जैसे गैसीय प्रकार के जैव-भू-रासायनिक पोषक चक्रों का मुख्य जलाशय कहाँ स्थित होता है?
oe: Deep inner stratospheric gas channels
The global atmosphere or hydrosphere
The high-density lithosphere earth crust layer
The ionospheric upper plasma tracking layer

Subtropical shrubby forest domains
Desert ecosystem

oe: Open water pelagic zone channel
Deep dark benthic zone floor
Still water lentic zone system
Littoral zone interface

• Option 2 is Incorrect because benthic zone bottom sediment substrate layer hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because littoral zone lake ya marine coastline ka shallow shoreline interface hai jo cyclic tidal rhythms ya water-level shifts ke sath alternatively water me submerge aur air me expose hota rehta hai.

qe: What specific environmental criteria group defines the operational scope of edaphic factors within an ecosystem?

Physical and chemical properties of the soil matrix, including texture, topography, and pH
Solar light wavelength and cloud cover profiles
Altitude variations tracked relative to standard sea level

मृदा मैट्रिक्स के भौतिक और रासायनिक गुण, जिसमें बनावट, स्थलाकृति और पीएच शामिल हैं
सौर प्रकाश तरंग दैर्ध्य और क्लाउड कवर प्रोफाइल
मानक समुद्र तल के सापेक्ष ऊंचाई भिन्नता

Abiotic ecosystem drivers primarily climatic, topographic, aur edaphic components me classify kiye jaate hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because humidity aur wind atmospheric climatic factors hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because edaphic factors soil substrate ke physical, chemical, aur biological attributes se directly relate karte hain, jaise soil grain texture, mineral composition, water holding capacity, topography, aur pH levels.

oe: Systematic global nutrient cycling operations
Active prevention of topsoil erosion via root grids
Pollutant absorption and baseline greenhouse gas regulation to curb global warming
All of the above combined ecological benefits

• Option 1 is Correct because biogeochemical nutrient cycling (nitrogen, phosphorus, carbon) ecosystems ki fundamental supporting service hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because forest vegetative cover aur plant root mesh topsoil cohesion provide karke erosion prevent karte hain.

• Option 3 is Correct because wetlands aur forests natural water/air filters aur major carbon sinks ke roop me climate regulation perform karte hain.

• Option 4 is Correct because options 1, 2, aur 3 sabhi verified ecological services hain, isliye all of the above right selection hai.

qe: Which term describes a primary biological mechanism that allows specialized saprotrophs to break down complex organic materials into inorganic nutrients?
qh: वह कौन सी प्राथमिक जैविक प्रक्रिया है जो विशिष्ट मृतोपजीवियों (saprotrophs) को जटिल कार्बनिक पदार्थों को अकार्बनिक पोषक तत्वों में तोड़ने की अनुमति देती है?

• Option 2 is Correct because saprotrophs (fungi aur bacteria) dead organic detritus par extracellular enzymes (cellulases, proteases, ligninases) secrete karte hain, jo insoluble polymers ko simple soluble molecules me tod dete hain jinhe absorb kiya jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because polymer cross-linking decay process ka mechanism nahi hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because organic matter spontaneous ether conversion follow nahi karta.

qe: What precise change in chemical state defines the biological process of humification within an ecosystem's soil layer?
qh: पारिस्थितिक तंत्र की मिट्टी की परत के भीतर 'ह्यूमीकरण' (humification) की प्रक्रिया को क्या परिभाषित करता है?

• Option 4 is Incorrect because salt precipitation humification define nahi karta.

qe: Why does a marine aquatic ecosystem characteristically display an inverted geometric profile for its pyramid of biomass?
qh: एक समुद्री जलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (marine ecosystem) अपने जैवभार के पिरामिड के लिए एक उल्टा ज्यामितीय प्रोफ़ाइल क्यों प्रदर्शित करता है?

The high reproductive turnover rate and short lifespan of microscopic phytoplankton support a much larger mass of longer-lived consumer fish
Because the water medium forces phosphodiester backbones to cross-link randomly
Because the system experiences a complete lack of asymmetric chiral modules

क्योंकि पानी का माध्यम फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बैकबोन को बेतरतीब ढंग से क्रॉस-लिंक करने के लिए मजबूर करता है
क्योंकि सिस्टम असममित काइरल मॉड्यूल की पूर्ण कमी का अनुभव करता है
e:
Aquatic systems me producers aur consumers ke life cycles aur physiological turnovers ka mismatch biomass inverted shapes develop karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because animal consumers starches me convert nahi hote.

• Option 2 is Correct because marine phytoplankton ka individual lifespan bohot chhota hota hai par inka turnover/reproduction rate extremely high hota hai; isliye unka small standing biomass ek much larger standing biomass of long-lived zooplankton aur fishes ko continuously support kar leta hai, causing an inverted biomass pyramid.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because water medium phosphodiester cross-linking induce nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because biochemical chirality ecological biomass distribution ko directly govern nahi karti.

qe: Which structural biological organism acts as an autotrophic producer within freshwater ecosystems, utilizing chlorophyll to fix carbon?

Spirogyra filamentous green algae

Epidermophyton dermatophyte skin tracking unit

स्पाइरोगाइरा फिलामेंटस हरी शैवाल
क्लैविसेप्स पुरपुरिया विशिष्ट एर्गोट कॉम्प्लेक्स
एपिडर्मोफाइटन डर्मेटोफाइट स्किन ट्रैकिंग यूनिट

Freshwater food webs autotrophic green algae aur macrophytes par primary energy production ke liye rely karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Agaricus ek saprotrophic fungus hai jisme photosynthetic pigments absent hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Spirogyra ek freshwater filamentous green alga (Chlorophyceae) hai jisme active chlorophyll pigments hote hain jo solar radiation utilize karke carbon fixation karte hain aur aquatic primary producer banate hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Claviceps purpurea parasitic fungus hai jo grasses par ergot disease cause karta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Epidermophyton pathogenic skin dermatophyte fungus hai.

qe: Which operational parameter represents the principal baseline constraint that limits the net primary productivity of open deep ocean ecosystems globally?
qh: कौन सा परिचालन पैरामीटर उस मुख्य बाधा का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो वैश्विक स्तर पर खुले गहरे महासागर प्रणालियों की शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता को सीमित करती है?

The lack of essential inorganic nutrients (like nitrogen and phosphorus) and light penetration limits in deeper zones
The continuous high-pressure cross-linking of surface carbon molecules
The sudden spontaneous conversion of dissolved oxygen into volatile alkanes

आवश्यक अकार्बनिक पोषक तत्वों (जैसे नाइट्रोजन और फास्फोरस) की कमी और गहरे क्षेत्रों में प्रकाश प्रवेश की सीमाएं
सतह के कार्बन अणुओं का निरंतर उच्च-दबाव क्रॉस-लिंकिंग
घुलित ऑक्सीजन का वाष्पशील एल्केन्स में अचानक स्वतः रूपांतरण
e:
Marine primary productivity photic zone depth aur oceanic nutrient recycling mechanisms par directly dependent hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because open oceans me nitric acid abundance biological factor nahi hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because open oceans me solar light sirf upper photic zone (~200m) tak penetrate karti hai, aur critical limiting nutrients (nitrogen, phosphorus, iron) gravity se bottom layers me settle ho jate hain; upwelling ke bina upper sunlit layer nutrient-deficient rehti hai, limiting overall NPP.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because chemical cross-linking oceanic productivity ka limitation factor nahi hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because dissolved oxygen alkanes me spontaneous convert nahi hota.

qe: What structural geometry profile describes the unique configuration of an ecosystem's pyramid of energy across global ecology models?
qh: वैश्विक पारिस्थितिकी मॉडलों में ऊर्जा का पिरामिड (pyramid of energy) किस विशिष्ट ज्यामितीय विन्यास को प्रदर्शित करता है?
oe: It can be either upright or inverted based on consumer counts
It is strictly and universally always upright due to thermodynamic dissipation rules
It matches an inverted geometric form across all aquatic systems
It shifts into an unaligned irregular grid framework when cooled
oh: उपभोक्ता संख्या के आधार पर यह सीधा या उल्टा हो सकता है
थर्मोडायनामिक अपव्यय नियमों के कारण यह सख्ती से और सार्वभौमिक रूप से हमेशा सीधा होता है
यह सभी जलीय प्रणालियों में एक उल्टे ज्यामितीय रूप से मेल खाता है

e:
Trophic energy dynamics strictly Second Law of Thermodynamics ke heat loss principles follow karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because energy pyramids kabhi bhi inverted nahi ho sakte chahe consumer count kitna bhi high ho.

• Option 2 is Correct because producer level se higher trophic tiers ki taraf energy transfer hone par 80–90% energy metabolic respiration aur heat dissipation ke roop me lost ho jati hai; since energy flow unidirectional hai aur consecutive levels par strictly decrease hoti hai, pyramid of energy hamesha aur universally upright hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because aquatic systems me biomass pyramid inverted ho sakta hai, par energy pyramid strictly upright rehta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because temperature changes energy pyramid ke structural orientation ko alter nahi karte.

Approximately 2-10 percent of active PAR energy
Exactly 50 percent balanced conversion index
Greater than 90 percent total solar tracking limits

e:
PAR (400–700 nm) sunlight ka wo fraction hai jise photosynthetic pigments absorb karne me physiologically capable hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 0.1% photosynthetic utilization threshold se substantially low hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because plants par fall hone wale total incident solar radiation ka <50% PAR hota hai, aur is available PAR ka sirf 2-10% part hi plants capture karke Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) ke form me chemical biomass me synthesize kar pate hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 50% energy capture photo-chemical reaction mechanisms ke thermodynamic saturation ke karan impossible hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because solar energy capture efficiency 90% tak reach nahi karti.

qe: Why does a tropical rain forest floor exhibit an exceptionally thin humus layer despite experiencing massive annual leaf fall and detritus input?
qh: अत्यधिक मात्रा में पत्तियों के गिरने और कार्बनिक पदार्थों के इनपुट के बावजूद एक उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन के फर्श पर ह्यूमस की परत असाधारण रूप से पतली क्यों होती है?
oe: Because topsoil carbohydrates convert spontaneously into volatile organic solvents
High temperature and high humidity environmental parameters drive rapid, near-instantaneous microbial decomposition by soil saprotrophs
Because the parent trees establish a permanent cross-linked polymer coat over soil
Because the system faces a total loss of ionizable phosphate backbones
oh: क्योंकि ऊपरी मिट्टी के कार्बोहाइड्रेट स्वतः ही वाष्पशील कार्बनिक विलायकों में परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं
उच्च तापमान और उच्च आर्द्रता वाले पर्यावरणीय पैरामीटर मिट्टी के मृतोपजीवियों द्वारा तेजी से अपघटन को संचालित करते हैं
क्योंकि मूल वृक्ष मिट्टी पर एक स्थायी क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बहुलक आवरण स्थापित करते हैं
क्योंकि सिस्टम आयननीय फॉस्फेट बैकबोन के कुल नुकसान का सामना करता है
e:
Humus accumulation organic matter input rate aur microbial decomposition kinetics ke dynamic balance par depend karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because organic detritus solvents me evaporate nahi hota.

• Option 2 is Correct because tropical rain forests me continuously high ambient temperature aur abundant humidity soil microflora (bacteria aur fungi) ko hyper-active rakhti hain; girha hua detritus near-instantaneously decompose aur mineralize ho jata hai, jisse thick humus layer assemble nahi ho pati.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because biological trees soil par synthetic polymer coat nahi banate.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because phosphate cycles humus layer decomposition kinetics ka core physical reason nahi hain.

qe: What physical process allocates the remaining 90 percent of energy that enters a specific herbivore trophic level but fails to build new consumer biomass?
qh: वह कौन सी शारीरिक प्रक्रिया है जो उस शेष 90 प्रतिशत ऊर्जा को खर्च करती है जो एक शाकाहारी ट्रॉफिक स्तर में प्रवेश करती है लेकिन नया जीवभार बनाने में विफल रहती है?
oe: The continuous free-radical polymerization of structural dipeptides
Losses driven by cellular respiration, metabolic maintenance, and dissipation as environmental heat
The conversion of sugar backbones into unbranched linear caprolactam lines
The spontaneous induction of standard cell electrode potential drops
oh: संरचनात्मक डाइपेप्टाइड्स का निरंतर मुक्त-रेडिकल पोलीमराइजेशन
कोशिकीय श्वसन, चयापचय रखरखाव और पर्यावरणीय गर्मी के रूप में अपव्यय द्वारा संचालित नुकसान
चीनी बैकबोन का अशाखित रैखिक कैप्रोलैक्टम लाइनों में रूपांतरण
मानक सेल इलेक्ट्रोड क्षमता में गिरावट का सहज प्रेरण
e:
Trophic level par consumed energy assimilation, somatic growth, aur basic life sustenance mechanisms me partition hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because dipeptide free-radical polymerization physiological energy loss mechanism nahi hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because consumed energy ka bulk (~90%) organisms apne basal metabolic activities, cellular respiration, locomotion, thermoregulation, aur unassimilated waste generation me spend karte hain jo ultimately heat ke form me environment me dissipate ho jati hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because biological metabolism caprolactam lines synthesize nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because electrode potential drops trophic energy loss budget ko explain nahi karte.

qe: What structural architectural term defines the sequential series of transitional biological communities that replace one another within a specific area during ecological succession?
qh: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रमण के दौरान एक विशिष्ट क्षेत्र के भीतर क्रमिक रूप से बदलने वाले जैविक समुदायों की पूरी श्रृंखला को क्या कहा जाता है?
oe: Cistronic isolated unit matrix
Sere or Seral stages
Monocistronic variant assembly
Novolac line layout cluster
oh: सिस्ट्रोनिक पृथक इकाई मैट्रिक्स
क्रमक / सेरल चरण (Sere or Seral stages)
मोनोसिस्ट्रोनिक संस्करण असेंबली
नोवोलैक लाइन लेआउट क्लस्टर
e:
Ecological succession me pioneer species se lekar terminal climax community tak poora ecosystem structural phases se guzarta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because cistron molecular genetics ka structural gene unit hota hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because kisi given habitat me ecological succession ke dauran systematically develop aur replace hone wali transitional communities ki poori sequential series ko 'Sere' kaha jata hai, aur har transitional community stage ko 'Seral Stage' kehte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because monocistronic terminology mRNA transcription unit ko denote karti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Novolac polymer chemistry ka precursor material hai.

qe: Which architectural system attribute characterizes a mature climax community, separating it clearly from early pioneer seral stages?
qh: एक परिपक्व चरम समुदाय (climax community) की कौन सी विशेषता इसे शुरुआती अग्रणी सेरल चरणों से स्पष्ट रूप से अलग करती है?
oe: High volatility parameters driving rapid random adjustments
Maximum species diversity, complex food webs, and advanced structural niche specialization
The complete absence of core histone octamer units inside organisms
An immutable reliance on linear unbranched polyolefin tail loops
oh: तीव्र यादृच्छिक समायोजन को संचालित करने वाले उच्च अस्थिरता पैरामीटर
अधिकतम प्रजाति विविधता, जटिल खाद्य जाल, और उन्नत संरचनात्मक आला (niche) विशेषज्ञता
जीवों के अंदर कोर हिस्टोन ऑक्टैमर इकाइयों की पूर्ण अनुपस्थिति
रैखिक अशाखित पॉलीओलेफ़िन पूंछ छोरों पर एक अपरिवर्तनीय निर्भरता
e:
Pioneer stages simple aur fragile hoti hain, jabki climax communities structural complexity aur homeostasis exhibit karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because climax communities low volatility aur high environmental stability show karti hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because mature climax stage high species richness, intricate multi-trophic food webs, high biomass accumulation, aur specialized ecological niche partitioning develop karti hai jo use dynamic equilibrium provide karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because eukaryotic histones universal molecular cellular structures hain jinka succession stage se correlation nahi hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because polyolefin loops synthetic chemical concepts hain.

qe: Which specific nutrient biogeochemical cycle does not experience major atmospheric gas mass losses driven by cellular respiration pathways?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट पोषक तत्व जैव-भू-रासायनिक चक्र (biogeochemical cycle) कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा संचालित प्रमुख वायुमंडलीय गैसीय हानि का अनुभव नहीं करता है?
oe: The global carbon cycle exclusively
The biochemical oxygen pathway matrix
The phosphorus sedimentary cycle
The volatile open-chain carbohydrate cycle
oh: विशेष रूप से वैश्विक कार्बन चक्र
जैव रासायनिक ऑक्सीजन मार्ग मैट्रिक्स
फास्फोरस अवसादी चक्र (Phosphorus cycle)
वाष्पशील खुली श्रृंखला कार्बोहाइड्रेट चक्र
e:
Biogeochemical nutrient pathways gaseous reservoir cycles aur sedimentary reservoir cycles me divided hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because carbon cycle cellular respiration se direct gaseous $\text{CO}_2$ release cycle karta hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because oxygen cellular respiration me direct metabolic terminal electron acceptor ke roop me atmospheric exchange karta hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because phosphorus cycle ek sedimentary cycle hai jiska main reservoir rock phosphate deposits (lithosphere) me hota hai; isme koi significant gaseous respiratory release component exist nahi karta aur cycling soil-water-biotic matrix me confine rehti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because carbohydrate metabolism directly carbon respiratory pathways ka hissa hota hai.

qe: What correct sequence maps the progressive structural layout stages of primary hydrarch succession, starting from open deep water towards a forest condition?
qh: गहरे पानी से शुरू होकर वन स्थिति की ओर बढ़ने वाले प्राथमिक जलारंभी अनुक्रमण (hydrarch succession) के चरणों का सही क्रम कौन सा है?
oe: Sedges $\rightarrow$ meadow $\rightarrow$ phytoplankton $\rightarrow$ reed swamp $\rightarrow$ forest trees
Phytoplankton $\rightarrow$ rooted submerged hydrophytes $\rightarrow$ floating hydrophytes $\rightarrow$ reed swamp $\rightarrow$ sedge-meadow $\rightarrow$ woodland trees
Free-floating hydrophytes $\rightarrow$ sedges $\rightarrow$ woodland $\rightarrow$ rooted submerged forms
Woodland trees $\rightarrow$ meadow blocks $\rightarrow$ phytoplankton stage $\rightarrow$ single core rings
oh: सेज $\rightarrow$ घास का मैदान $\rightarrow$ पादपप्लवक $\rightarrow$ नरकुल दलदल $\rightarrow$ वन वृक्ष
पादपप्लवक $\rightarrow$ जड़ वाले जलमग्न पौधे $\rightarrow$ तैरते हुए पौधे $\rightarrow$ नरकुल दलदल $\rightarrow$ सेज-घास का मैदान $\rightarrow$ वुडलैंड पेड़
मुक्त-तैरने वाले हाइड्रोफाइट्स $\rightarrow$ सेज $\rightarrow$ वुडलैंड $\rightarrow$ जड़ वाले जलमग्न रूप
वुडलैंड के पेड़ $\rightarrow$ घास के मैदान के ब्लॉक $\rightarrow$ पादपप्लवक चरण $\rightarrow$ एकल कोर के छल्ले
e:
Hydrosere open aquatic conditions se progressively siltation aur biomass deposition ke sath terrestrial woodland me convert hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because phytoplankton initial stage hoti hai aur sedges terminal terrestrial transition se pehle aate hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because accurate developmental chronosequence hai: Phytoplankton (Pioneers) $\rightarrow$ Rooted Submerged hydrophytes $\rightarrow$ Floating hydrophytes $\rightarrow$ Reed-Swamp stage $\rightarrow$ Sedge-Meadow stage $\rightarrow$ Woodland stage $\rightarrow$ Climax forest trees.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because rooted submerged plants free-floating forms se pehle stabilize hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because sequence inverted order me arrange ki gayi hai.

qe: Where does the global biogeochemical reservoir pool for sedimentary-type nutrient cycles like phosphorus and calcium reside?
qh: फास्फोरस और कैल्शियम जैसे अवसादी प्रकार के पोषक चक्रों (sedimentary-type nutrient cycles) का वैश्विक जलाशय कहाँ स्थित होता है?
oe: The upper stratospheric gas cloud layer
The atmosphere and adjacent open hydrosphere
The Earth's crust or lithosphere
The ionospheric high-density plasma tracking well
oh: ऊपरी समतापमंडलीय गैस मेघ परत
वायुमंडल और निकटवर्ती खुला जलमंडल
पृथ्वी की पपड़ी या स्थलमंडल (Lithosphere)
आयनमंडलीय उच्च घनत्व प्लाज्मा ट्रैकिंग वेल
e:
Sedimentary cycles gaseous cycles se isliye differ karte hain kyunki unka major reservoir geological rocks me locked hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because stratosphere sedimentary elements hold nahi karta.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because atmosphere gaseous cycle components (nitrogen, carbon) ka reservoir hota hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because sedimentary biogeochemical cycles (jaise phosphorus, calcium, aur sulfur) ka primary baseline reservoir pool Earth ki crust ya lithosphere (mineral rock formations) me sthit hota hai, jahan se weathering ke through nutrients release hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because ionospheric layers chemical nutrient cycling me involved nahi hain.

qe: If fixed carbon atoms move through a continuous grazing food chain spanning exactly four distinct species, what specific trophic level applies to the final species?
qh: यदि स्थिर कार्बन परमाणु ठीक चार अलग-अलग प्रजातियों में फैले एक निरंतर चराई खाद्य जाल से गुजरते हैं, तो अंतिम प्रजाति पर कौन सा विशिष्ट ट्रॉफिक स्तर लागू होता है?
oe: Primary producer level ($T_1$)
Primary consumer level ($T_2$)
Secondary consumer level ($T_3$)
Tertiary consumer level ($T_4$)
oh: प्राथमिक उत्पादक स्तर ($T_1$)
प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता स्तर ($T_2$)
द्वितीयक उपभोक्ता स्तर ($T_3$)
तृतीयक उपभोक्ता स्तर ($T_4$)
e:
Grazing food chains green plants se shuru hokar carnivores tak sequential step transfers ke form me proceed karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because $T_1$ pehla step hota hai jo autotrophs occupy karte hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because $T_2$ second species (herbivore) ko represent karta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because $T_3$ third species (primary carnivore) ka tier hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because 4 species ki food chain ka order: Species 1 (Primary Producer, $T_1$) $\rightarrow$ Species 2 (Primary Consumer/Herbivore, $T_2$) $\rightarrow$ Species 3 (Secondary Consumer/Primary Carnivore, $T_3$) $\rightarrow$ Species 4 (Tertiary Consumer/Secondary Carnivore, $T_4$); isliye final species $T_4$ level par aayegi.

qe: Which major global ecosystem biome develops inside a geographic territory where mean annual precipitation metrics sit below 100 mm and potential evaporation parameters exceed rainfall inputs?
qh: उस भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में कौन सा प्रमुख वैश्विक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र बायोम विकसित होता है जहां औसत वार्षिक वर्षा 100 मिमी से कम होती है और संभावित वाष्पीकरण दर वर्षा से अधिक होती है?
oe: Temperate open grassland systems
Subtropical shrubby forest domains
Desert biome
Saline coastal mangrove wetlands
oh: शीतोष्ण खुले घास के मैदान
उप-उष्णकटिबंधीय झाड़ीदार वन क्षेत्र
मरुस्थलीय बायोम (Desert biome)
खारे तटीय मैंग्रोव आर्द्रभूमि
e:
Arid biomes rainfall deficit, high thermal fluctuations, aur extreme evapotranspiration deficits se shape hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because temperate grasslands 25–75 cm rainfall sustain karte hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because shrubby forests (chaparral) seasonal rainfall patterns support karte hain.

• Option 3 is Correct because desert biomes extreme moisture stress condition me develop hote hain, jahan mean annual precipitation consistently 100 mm se kam rehti hai aur evapotranspiration rate rainfall se significantly zyada hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because mangrove ecosystems saline waterlogging me survive karte hain.

qe: What architectural terminology specifies the littoral zone found along aquatic lake or marine coast setups?
qh: जलीय झील या समुद्री तट के किनारे पाए जाने वाले वेलांचली क्षेत्र (littoral zone) की क्या संरचनात्मक विशेषता है?
oe: Deep open water pools missing light entirely
The shallow shoreline margin that is alternatively exposed to air currents and immersed under water levels
The bottom aphotic zone floor where decomposers accumulate
A rigid cross-linked coordination node slot locked by salts
oh: गहरे खुले पानी के पूल जिनमें प्रकाश की पूरी तरह से कमी है
उथला तटीय किनारा जो वैकल्पिक रूप से हवा के संपर्क में आता है और पानी के नीचे डूब जाता है
निचला अप्रकाशित ज़ोन तल जहां अपघटक जमा होते हैं
लवणों द्वारा बंद एक कठोर क्रॉस-लिंक्ड समन्वय नोड स्लॉट
e:
Aquatic water bodies depth aur distance from shore ke basis par vertical aur horizontal zones me zonate hoti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because deep open water limnetic ya profundal zones form karta hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because littoral zone lake ya marine coastline ka wo shallow boundary zone hai jahan sunlight bottom tak penetrate karti hai aur jo wave action ya tidal dynamics ke karan alternatively water me submerge aur dry atmosphere me expose hota rehta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because aphotic bottom layer ko benthic/profundal zone kehte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because inorganic salt coordination littoral ecology ka descriptor nahi hai.

qe: Which dynamic property acts as an edaphic factor parameter, dictating the operational profile of a terrestrial ecosystem?
qh: कौन सा गतिशील गुण एक मृदीय कारक (edaphic factor) के रूप में कार्य करता है, जो स्थलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र के परिचालन प्रोफ़ाइल को निर्देशित करता है?
oe: Ambient relative humidity and seasonal wind velocities
The physical and chemical composition of the soil matrix, including texture and pH
Solar radiation intensity shifts tracking daily cycles
Atmospheric pressure variations calculated relative to sea level
oh: परिवेशी सापेक्षिक आर्द्रता और मौसमी हवा का वेग
मृदा मैट्रिक्स की भौतिक और रासायनिक संरचना, जिसमें बनावट और पीएच शामिल हैं
दैनिक चक्रों को ट्रैक करने वाले सौर विकिरण तीव्रता में बदलाव
समुद्र तल के सापेक्ष गणना की गई वायुमंडलीय दबाव भिन्नताएं
e:
Edaphic factors terrestrial ecosystems ke soil-related physical, chemical, aur biological components ko refer karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because humidity aur wind speed aerial climatic variables hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because soil profile ki physical properties (texture, grain size, porosity, water holding capacity) aur chemical properties (pH, mineral content, organic matter) directly edaphic factors represent karti hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because solar radiation illumination climatic variable hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because atmospheric pressure barometric factor hai, edaphic nahi.

qe: Which cornerstone biochemical and physical regulation function represents an invaluable ecosystem service naturally supplied by intact, healthy biomes?
qh: कौन सा महत्वपूर्ण कार्य प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों द्वारा प्रदान की जाने वाली एक अमूल्य पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र सेवा (ecosystem service) का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
oe: Systematic global nutrient cycling operations
Active prevention of topsoil erosion via root grids
Pollutant absorption and baseline greenhouse gas regulation to curb global warming
All of the above combined ecological benefits
oh: व्यवस्थित वैश्विक पोषक चक्र संचालन
रूट ग्रिड के माध्यम से ऊपरी मिट्टी के कटाव की सक्रिय रोकथाम
ग्लोबल वार्मिंग को रोकने के लिए प्रदूषक अवशोषण और ग्रीनहाउस गैस विनियमन
उपरोक्त सभी संयुक्त पारिस्थितिक लाभ
e:
Natural ecosystems biosphere ki stability aur human economic-ecological survival ke liye essential services deliver karte hain.

• Option 1 is a verified ecosystem service because biogeochemical nutrient cycling (carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus) ecosystem ki foundational supporting service hai.

• Option 2 is a verified ecosystem service because plant root networks soil particles ko bind karke water aur wind erosion prevent karte hain (regulating service).

• Option 3 is a verified ecosystem service because forests aur oceans excessive carbon dioxide sink karke global warming mitigate karte hain aur pollutants absorb karte hain.

• Option 4 is Correct because options 1, 2, aur 3 teeno verified ecosystem services hain, isliye 'All of the above' correct option hai.

qe: What precise role do saprotrophs play in a natural ecosystem's nutrient dynamics?
qh: प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र के पोषक तत्व गतिकी में मृतोपजीवियों (saprotrophs) की क्या भूमिका है?
oe: They synthesize biomass directly from sunlight
They decompose dead organic matter, releasing inorganic minerals back into the soil
They act as tertiary predators in grazing food chains
They facilitate the rapid evaporation of soil water
oh: वे सीधे सूर्य के प्रकाश से जैवभार का संश्लेषण करते हैं
वे मृत कार्बनिक पदार्थों का अपघटन करते हैं, जिससे अकार्बनिक खनिज वापस मिट्टी में मिल जाते हैं
वे चराई खाद्य श्रृंखलाओं में तृतीयक शिकारियों के रूप में कार्य करते हैं
वे मिट्टी के पानी के तेजी से वाष्पीकरण की सुविधा प्रदान करते हैं
e:
Saprotrophs biosphere ke essential recycling agents hote hain jo nutrient loop ko close karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because solar biomass synthesis autotrophic producers ka function hota hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because saprotrophic bacteria aur fungi dead plant aur animal residues ko enzymatically decompose karte hain, jisse bound mineral elements soil solution me wapas recycle ho jate hain aur autotrophs ke re-uptake ke liye available bante hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because saprotrophs decomposer food chain ka part hote hain, grazing predators nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because soil water evaporation physical climatic process hai.

qe: What biochemical transformation defines the mineralization stage in decomposition?
qh: अपघटन (decomposition) के दौरान 'खनिजीकरण' (mineralization) चरण को कौन सी जैव रासायनिक प्रक्रिया परिभाषित करती है?
oe: Conversion of inorganic nutrients into complex sugars
The release of inorganic ions (like $\text{NH}_4^+$, $\text{K}^+$, $\text{Mg}^{2+}$) from dead organic matter
The rapid polymerization of cellular proteins
The sublimation of humus into atmospheric gases
oh: अकार्बनिक पोषक तत्वों का जटिल शर्करा में रूपांतरण
मृत कार्बनिक पदार्थों से अकार्बनिक आयनों (जैसे $\text{NH}_4^+$, $\text{K}^+$, $\text{Mg}^{2+}$) का विमोचन
सेलुलर प्रोटीन का तेजी से पोलीमराइजेशन
ह्यूमस का वायुमंडलीय गैसों में उर्ध्वपातन
e:
Decomposition me fragmentation, leaching, catabolism, humification aur mineralization ke sequential stages hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because inorganic compounds se sugars banana photosynthesis ka kaam hai, mineralization ka nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because mineralization wo terminal biochemical step hai jahan soil microorganisms humus aur organic residues ko degrade karke simple inorganic ions jaise $\text{NH}_4^+$, $\text{K}^+$, $\text{Mg}^{2+}$, $\text{Ca}^{2+}$, $\text{PO}_4^{3-}$ soil solution me release karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because protein polymerization synthetic anabolic process hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because humus solid colloidal state me mineralize hota hai, sublimate nahi hota.

qe: Why is the biomass pyramid inverted in typical aquatic ecosystems?
qh: विशिष्ट जलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों (aquatic ecosystems) में जैवभार का पिरामिड (pyramid of biomass) उल्टा क्यों होता है?
oe: Because fish have higher biomass than algae
Because the biomass of consumers (fishes) exceeds that of producers (phytoplankton) due to high turnover rates
Because aquatic plants grow downwards in water
Because energy flows from the bottom to the top
oh: क्योंकि मछलियों का जैवभार शैवाल से अधिक होता है
क्योंकि उच्च टर्नओवर दर के कारण उपभोक्ताओं (मछलियों) का जैवभार उत्पादकों (पादपप्लवक) से अधिक हो जाता है
क्योंकि जलीय पौधे पानी में नीचे की ओर बढ़ते हैं
क्योंकि ऊर्जा नीचे से ऊपर की ओर बहती है
e:
Pyramid of biomass standing crop weight at a specific time par depend karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because yeh statement observation hai par accurate biological rationale explain nahi karta.

• Option 2 is Correct because aquatic ecosystems me primary producers (microscopic phytoplankton) ka turnover rate bohot fast hota hai aur lifespan bohot chhota hota hai; is fast turnover ki wajah se inka instantaneous standing crop biomass kam rehta hai, par ye apne se bohot bade biomass wale long-lived consumers (zooplankton aur fishes) ko sustain karte hain, jisse pyramid inverted banta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because plant growth direction biomass pyramid shape decide nahi karti.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because unidirectional energy flow universal law hai, inverted biomass ka specific reason nahi.

qe: Which specific organism is commonly mistaken for a producer but is actually a heterotrophic saprotroph?
qh: कौन सा जीव जिसे अक्सर उत्पादक मान लिया जाता है, वास्तव में एक परपोषी मृतोपजीवी (heterotrophic saprotroph) है?
oe: Spirogyra
Agaricus
Volvox
Nostoc
oh: स्पाइरोगाइरा
अगरिकस (मशरूम)
वॉल्वॉक्स
नॉस्टॉक
e:
Fungi morphological appearance me plants ki tarah soil me grow karte dikhte hain par biologically non-photosynthetic hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because *Spirogyra* photosynthetic green alga hai jo true autotrophic producer hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because *Agaricus* (common edible mushroom) Kingdom Fungi se belong karta hai; isme chlorophyll completely absent hota hai aur ye photosynthesis nahi kar sakta, balki dead organic compost par grow karke nutrition absorb karne wala heterotrophic saprotroph hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because *Volvox* autotrophic green colonial alga hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because *Nostoc* autotrophic cyanobacterium hai.

qe: Which ecosystem type ranks highest in terms of net primary production (NPP)?
qh: शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (net primary production - NPP) के मामले में कौन सा पारिस्थितिक तंत्र शीर्ष पर है?
oe: Desert ecosystems
Tropical rain forests
Open ocean ecosystems
Estuaries
oh: मरुस्थलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र
उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन
खुले महासागरीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र
ज्वारनदमुख (Estuaries)
e:
Net Primary Production rate climatic variables jaise temperature, moisture availability, aur photoperiod par directly depend karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because deserts water scarcity ke karan lowest NPP biomes me aate hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because tropical rain forests high year-round temperatures, abundant rainfall, aur dense canopy density provide karte hain, jisse inki annual Net Primary Productivity ($2000\text{ g/m}^2/\text{year}$) global biomes me highest rank karti hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because open oceans massive area cover karte hain par unki per-unit area productivity nutrient limitation ki wajah se low hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because estuaries highly productive aquatic habitats hain par terrestrial biomes me maximum net primary yield tropical forests compile karte hain.

qe: Why are ecological pyramids of energy always found in an upright orientation?
qh: ऊर्जा के पारिस्थितिक पिरामिड (pyramid of energy) हमेशा सीधे (upright) क्यों होते हैं?
oe: Because energy is created at each trophic level
Because energy is lost as heat at each trophic level according to thermodynamic laws
Because organisms store 100% of the energy they consume
Because biomass and energy are chemically identical
oh: क्योंकि प्रत्येक पोषी स्तर पर ऊर्जा का निर्माण होता है
क्योंकि ऊष्मागतिकी के नियमों के अनुसार प्रत्येक पोषी स्तर पर ऊर्जा ऊष्मा के रूप में नष्ट हो जाती है
क्योंकि जीव उपभोग की गई ऊर्जा का 100% भंडारण करते हैं
क्योंकि जैवभार और ऊर्जा रासायनिक रूप से समान हैं
e:
Ecosystems me trophic transfer efficiency thermodynamic dissipation rules se governed hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because First Law of Thermodynamics ke according energy create nahi ki ja sakti.

• Option 2 is Correct because Second Law of Thermodynamics ke mutabiq har trophic transfer ke dauran high amount of energy (~90%) metabolic maintenance, locomotion aur cellular respiration me heat bankar dissipate ho jati hai; consecutive levels par energy hamesha decrease hoti hai, isliye pyramid of energy universally upright hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 100% energy storage biologically impossible hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because biomass aur energy distinct physical parameters hain.

qe: What percentage of incident solar energy is estimated to be captured by autotrophs for photosynthesis?
qh: प्रकाश संश्लेषण (photosynthesis) के लिए स्वपोषियों (autotrophs) द्वारा कितनी सौर ऊर्जा को कैद किया जाता है?
oe: Less than 0.1%
e:
Global energy flux sun se autotrophic plants ke photosynthetic machinery ke through biosphere me enter hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because baseline fixation 0.1% se zyada hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because total incident solar radiation me se lagbhag 50% Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) hota hai; autotrophic plants is PAR ka lagbhag 2-10% (jo total solar radiation ka 1-5% banta hai) photosynthesis ke dauran chemical energy me convert karke store karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 30% solar conversion biological photosynthetic pigments ke absorption limits se bahar hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 50% entire PAR fraction ka benchmark hai, plant capture rate ka nahi.

qe: In which biome is the process of decomposition most rapid due to favorable moisture and temperature?
qh: अनुकूल नमी और तापमान के कारण किस बायोम (biome) में अपघटन (decomposition) की प्रक्रिया सबसे तेज होती है?
oe: Tropical rain forest
Antarctic tundra
Dry arid region
Alpine peaks
oh: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन
अंटार्कटिक टुंड्रा
शुष्क मरुस्थलीय क्षेत्र
अल्पाइन चोटियाँ
e:
Decomposition rate microflora enzyme kinetics, ambient moisture, aur optimum temperature par directly depend karta hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because high humidity aur continuously warm temperatures tropical rain forests me microbial decomposers (bacteria aur fungi) ke growth aur enzymatic metabolism ke liye perfect environment create karte hain, jisse organic matter ka breakdown fastest rate par hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Antarctic tundra ke freezing sub-zero temperatures microbial cellular enzymes ko inactivate kar dete hain, jisse decomposition completely stall ho jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because dry arid regions me severe moisture deficiency microbial survival aur enzymatic hydrolysis ko restrict karti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because alpine zones ke persistent low thermal regimes detrital breakdown kinetics ko decelerate karte hain.

qe: Approximately what fraction of herbivore productivity is transferred to primary carnivores, and what happens to the remaining portion?
qh: शाकाहारी उत्पादकता का कितना अंश प्राथमिक मांसाहारियों को स्थानांतरित होता है और शेष का क्या होता है?
oe: 90% transferred, 10% lost as heat
10% transferred, 90% lost to respiration and decomposers
40% transferred, 60% stored as sugar
100% transferred to next level
oh: 90% स्थानांतरित, 10% ऊष्मा के रूप में नष्ट
10% स्थानांतरित, 90% श्वसन और अपघटकों में व्यय
40% स्थानांतरित, 60% शर्करा के रूप में संग्रहीत
100% अगले स्तर पर स्थानांतरित
e:
Trophic level par consumed energy assimilation, somatic growth, aur basic life sustenance mechanisms me strictly partition hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 90% energy transfer biologically impossible hai, yeh thermodynamics ke energy dissipation laws ke against hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Lindeman's 10% law ke mutabiq herbivore productivity ka approximately 10% hi agle trophic tier (primary carnivores) ke biomass me convert hota hai; remaining 90% cellular respiration, metabolic heat dissipation, locomotion, aur death ke baad decomposers dwara consume ho jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because herbivores 40% conversion efficiency maintain nahi karte aur na hi energy bulk sugar me store karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 100% energy transfer impossible hai kyunki respiration me substantial thermodynamic heat loss hota hai.

qe: How are the changes in species composition during ecological succession described?
qh: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रमण (ecological succession) के दौरान प्रजातियों की संरचना में होने वाले परिवर्तनों का वर्णन कैसे किया जाता है?
oe: Random and unpredictable
Orderly and sequential
Very quick and chaotic
Influenced only by artificial environments
oh: यादृच्छिक और अप्रत्याशित
क्रमबद्ध और अनुक्रमिक
अत्यंत तीव्र और अराजक
केवल कृत्रिम वातावरण से प्रभावित
e:
Ecological succession environmental factors aur biological communities ke mutual interaction dwara directed structured ecological process hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because succession stochastic ya random sorting nahi balki directional progress manifest karta hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because ecological succession ek deterministic, gradual, aur predictable process hai jisme kisi given area me species composition me orderly aur sequential changes aate hain jab tak ki final climax community establish na ho jaye.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because natural community shifts instantaneous ya chaotic nahi hote balki decades-to-centuries me evolve hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because succession primarily pristine natural habitats me self-regulated environmental feedback loops par operate karta hai.

qe: A climax community is defined by its stability and state of:
qh: एक चरम समुदाय (climax community) की स्थिरता और किस स्थिति द्वारा परिभाषित किया जाता है?
oe: Non-equilibrium
Equilibrium
Disorder
Constant chaotic change
oh: गैर-संतुलन
संतुलन (Equilibrium)
अव्यवस्था
निरंतर अराजक परिवर्तन
e:
Climax community biotic succession ka terminal equilibrium state represent karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because climax stage unstable non-equilibrium me nahi balki high compositional stability me exist karti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because climax community ecological succession ka final, mature stage hai jo native physical environment aur macro-climate ke sath harmonious dynamic equilibrium me stabilize hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because mature climax systems highly organized vertical stratification aur niche specialization show karte hain, disorder nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because chaotic compositional changes pioneer stages ka trait ho sakte hain, resilient climax communities ka nahi.

qe: Why are phosphorus, nitrogen, and sulphur cycles classified as biogeochemical cycles that lack respiratory losses?
qh: फास्फोरस, नाइट्रोजन और सल्फर चक्रों को श्वसन-जनित हानि से मुक्त जैव-भू-रासायनिक चक्र क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: Because they are stored only in gas form
Because they do not have any gaseous components lost specifically through respiration processes
Because they only exist in deep oceans
Because they are entirely synthetic
oh: क्योंकि वे केवल गैस के रूप में संग्रहीत होते हैं
क्योंकि इनमें श्वसन प्रक्रियाओं के माध्यम से खो जाने वाले कोई विशिष्ट गैसीय घटक नहीं होते हैं
क्योंकि वे केवल गहरे महासागरों में मौजूद होते हैं
क्योंकि वे पूरी तरह से सिंथेटिक हैं
e:
Biogeochemical nutrient pathways me respiratory gas exchange specific metabolic molecules tak restricted rehta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because phosphorus aur sulfur sedimentary lithospheric pools me majorly store hote hain, gas me nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because cellular respiration me carbon aur oxygen directly $\text{CO}_2$ aur $\text{O}_2$ gas bankar exchange hote hain, jabki phosphorus, nitrogen, aur sulfur cycles biological respiration dwara direct atmospheric mass loss show nahi karte aur non-respiratory pathways se cycle hote hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because ye nutrient pools terrestrial soils aur upper crust me widely distributed hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because ye essential natural macronutrients hain, synthetic entities nahi.

qe: What is the typical pioneering stage in the aquatic succession of a hydrosere?
qh: जलीय अनुक्रमण (hydrosere) में प्रारंभिक अग्रणी चरण (pioneer stage) कौन सा है?
oe: Meadow stage
Phytoplankton
Submerged plants
Woodland trees
oh: घास का मैदान चरण (Meadow stage)
पादपप्लवक (Phytoplankton)
जलमग्न पौधे
वुडलैंड के पेड़
e:
Hydrarch succession standing open water bodies se shuru hokar mature mesic forest conditions ki taraf systematically progress karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because sedge-meadow stage transition sequence ke kafi late phase me develop hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because open deep water body me initial colonization microscopic autotrophs jaise diatoms aur green algae dwara hoti hai, jise pioneer stage ke roop me Phytoplankton stage kaha jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because rooted submerged hydrophytes phytoplankton ke organic silt deposition ke baad aate hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because woodland trees terminal climax stage represent karte hain, pioneer nahi.

qe: Where is the primary reservoir for gaseous biogeochemical nutrient cycles?
qh: गैसीय जैव-भू-रासायनिक पोषक चक्रों (gaseous biogeochemical cycles) के लिए प्राथमिक जलाशय कहाँ स्थित है?
oe: In the Earth's crust
In the Atmosphere
In the ionosphere
In the stratosphere
oh: पृथ्वी की पपड़ी में
वायुमंडल में (In the Atmosphere)
आयनमंडल में
समताप मंडल में
e:
Biogeochemical nutrient cycles ko unke primary active reservoir pool ke domain ke according divide kiya jata hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Earth's crust (lithosphere) sedimentary nutrient cycles jaise phosphorus, calcium, aur sulfur ka main reservoir hota hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because gaseous biogeochemical cycles (jaise Nitrogen cycle aur Carbon cycle) ka primary baseline reservoir pool Earth ka atmosphere aur hydrosphere hota hai jahan se elements rapidly exchange hote hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because ionospheric plasma layer biotic metabolic cycling me participate nahi karti.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because tropospheric ambient mixing biological life cycle support karti hai, upper stratosphere nahi.

qe: In a food chain, if carbon fixed by producers passes through three species, the final species is a:
qh: एक खाद्य श्रृंखला में, यदि उत्पादकों द्वारा स्थिर कार्बन तीन प्रजातियों से होकर गुजरता है, तो अंतिम प्रजाति कौन सी होगी?
oe: Primary consumer
Secondary consumer
Tertiary consumer
Scavenger
oh: प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता
द्वितीयक उपभोक्ता
तृतीयक उपभोक्ता (Tertiary consumer)
अपमार्जक (Scavenger)
e:
Linear grazing food chain me energy aur organic carbon discrete trophic tiers ($T_1, T_2, T_3, T_4$) ke through systematically propagate karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because primary consumer pehla consumer link ($T_2$) hota hai jo direct autotrophs ko consume karta hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because secondary consumer second consumer link ($T_3$) occupy karta hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because trophic progression ka flow hai: Producer ($T_1$) $\rightarrow$ First Consumer (Herbivore, $T_2$) $\rightarrow$ Second Consumer (Primary Carnivore, $T_3$) $\rightarrow$ Third Consumer (Secondary Carnivore, $T_4$); is continuous sequence me 3 consumer steps pass karne ke baad final species Tertiary Consumer ($T_4$) designate hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because scavenger specific feeding mode denote karta hai, sequential energy step hierarchy nahi.

qe: What biome characterizes a region with <100mm annual rainfall and high evaporation?
qh: 100 मिमी से कम वार्षिक वर्षा और उच्च वाष्पीकरण वाले क्षेत्र में किस प्रकार का बायोम (biome) पाया जाता है?
oe: Grassland
Desert
Shrubby forest
Mangrove
oh: घास का मैदान
मरुस्थल / रेगिस्तान (Desert)
झाड़ीदार वन
मैंग्रोव
e:
Global biomes distribution temperature aur precipitation ke net balance par heavily depend karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because grasslands typically 250 mm se 750 mm annual precipitation sustain karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because desert biomes extreme aridity se define hote hain jahan annual rainfall <100 mm hoti hai aur evapotranspiration rate precipitation inputs ko drastically exceed karti hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because shrubby forests (chaparral/scrub) moderate rainfall support karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because mangroves high-moisture intertidal coastal zones me thrive karte hain.

qe: The zone in a lake edge that is alternately exposed to air and water is the:
qh: झील के किनारे का वह क्षेत्र जो वैकल्पिक रूप से हवा और पानी के संपर्क में रहता है, कहलाता है:
oe: Pelagic zone
Littoral zone
Benthic zone
Lentic zone
oh: पेलाजिक ज़ोन
लिटोरल ज़ोन (Littoral zone)
बेंटिक ज़ोन
लेंटिक ज़ोन
e:
Aquatic ecosystem zonation light penetration, water depth, aur edge proximity ke adhar par operate karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because pelagic zone open offshore water mass ko signify karta hai jo shoreline interfaces se door hota hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because littoral zone lake ya marine coast ka wo shallow shoreline margin hai jo water level fluctuations aur tidal rhythms ke karan alternately atmosphere me expose aur water me submerge hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because benthic zone bottom sediment substrate layer ko represent karta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because lentic system entire standing freshwater ecosystems (lakes/ponds) ko kehte hain, edge interface ko nahi.

qe: Which of the following is considered an edaphic factor?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक मृदीय कारक (edaphic factor) है?
oe: Relative humidity
Soil
Altitude
Water
oh: सापेक्षिक आर्द्रता
मिट्टी (Soil)
ऊंचाई (Altitude)
पानी (Water)
e:
Abiotic factors terrestrial environments me climatic, topographic, aur edaphic classes me split hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because atmospheric humidity climatic factor category me belong karti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because edaphic factors specifically substratum aur soil characteristics (soil texture, mineral composition, grain size, pH, organic content) ko encompass karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because altitude physiographic/topographic factor hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because rainfall precipitation climatic/hydrological driver me include hota hai.

qe: Which of these is a direct ecosystem service provided by natural biomes?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र द्वारा प्रदान की जाने वाली पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र सेवा (ecosystem service) है?
oe: Pollination of crops
Reduction of soil nutrients
Increase in global temperature
None of these
oh: फसलों का परागण (Pollination of crops)
मिट्टी के पोषक तत्वों में कमी
वैश्विक तापमान में वृद्धि
इनमें से कोई नहीं
e:
Ecosystem services natural intact ecological systems dwara provided tangible benefits aur regulatory functions hain.

• Option 1 is Correct because insects, birds, aur bats dwara performed natural pollination of crops ek foundational ecosystem service hai jo global agriculture aur food security ko sustain karti hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because natural ecosystems nutrient recycling run karte hain, soil nutrients degrade nahi karte.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because intact ecosystems carbon sequester karke climate stabilization karte hain, temperature hike nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Option 1 ek well-established direct ecosystem service hai.

qe: What characterizes the primary consumer in an aquatic ecosystem?
qh: एक जलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता (primary consumer) की क्या विशेषता है?
oe: It is always a shark
They are zooplanktons
They act as decomposers
They fix solar radiation directly
oh: यह हमेशा एक शार्क होती है
वे प्राणीप्लवक (Zooplanktons) हैं
वे अपघटक के रूप में कार्य करते हैं
वे सौर विकिरण को सीधे स्थिर करते हैं
e:
Aquatic grazing food chains microscopic phytoplankton producers se shuru hokar herbivorous consumers ki taraf flow karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because sharks apex tertiary/quaternary consumers occupy karti hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because aquatic food chains me microscopic photosynthetic algae (phytoplankton) primary producers hote hain, aur unpar direct graze karne wale zooplankton (protozoans, micro-crustaceans) primary consumers ($T_2$) act karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because zooplanktons living biomass consume karte hain, detrital saprotrophy perform nahi karte.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because zooplankton heterotrophs hote hain aur solar fixation perform nahi kar sakte.

qe: Why is the rate of energy assimilation at the herbivore level called secondary productivity?
qh: शाकाहारी स्तर पर ऊर्जा के आत्मसात करने की दर को द्वितीयक उत्पादकता (secondary productivity) क्यों कहा जाता है?
oe: Because it is independent of producers
Because the biomass available to consumers is derived from the primary productivity of autotrophs
Because it produces oxygen
Because it happens in the dark
oh: क्योंकि यह उत्पादकों से स्वतंत्र है
क्योंकि उपभोक्ताओं के लिए उपलब्ध जैवभार स्वपोषियों की प्राथमिक उत्पादकता से प्राप्त होता है
क्योंकि यह ऑक्सीजन का उत्पादन करता है
क्योंकि यह अंधेरे में होता है
e:
Productivity metrics biosynthesis ke origin level ke basis par primary aur secondary categories me bifurcate hoti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because secondary productivity completely autotrophs ke plant inputs par depend karti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because autotrophs dwara synthesized basic organic biomass ko Primary Productivity kehte hain; jab herbivores is plant biomass ko consume aur digest karke apne consumer body tissues me assimilate karte hain, toh us rate of new organic synthesis ko Secondary Productivity kaha jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because herbivores respiratory oxygen utilize karte hain, release nahi karte.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because metabolic secondary assimilation light-independent biological digestion process hai.

qe: What defines a self-sustainable ecosystem?
qh: स्व-स्थायी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (self-sustainable ecosystem) किसे कहते हैं?
oe: One that requires daily external nutrients
A system that maintains itself by its own independent efforts
One that only exists in laboratories
One that relies on artificial light
oh: वह जिसे दैनिक बाहरी पोषक तत्वों की आवश्यकता होती है
एक प्रणाली जो अपने स्वयं के स्वतंत्र प्रयासों से खुद को बनाए रखती है
वह जो केवल प्रयोगशालाओं में मौजूद है
वह जो कृत्रिम प्रकाश पर निर्भर करता है
e:
Ecological homeostasis biotic aur abiotic components ke autonomous interaction se maintain hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because artificial subsidy par dependent systems self-sustainable nahi hote.

• Option 2 is Correct because self-sustainable ecosystem wo natural system hai jo solar energy input ke sath apne internal nutrient cycles (producers, consumers, decomposers) aur energy flows ko independently maintain aur balance karta hai bina kisi continuous external human intervention ke.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because pristine forests, lakes, aur oceans natural self-sustaining units hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because natural sunlight ecosystems ka sustainable primary energy driver hota hai.

qe: Which of these is a characteristic plant of a tropical deciduous forest ecosystem in India?
qh: भारत में उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती वन पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (tropical deciduous forest) का एक विशिष्ट पौधा कौन सा है?
oe: Tectona
Mangrove roots
Arctic moss
Cactus
oh: सागौन (Tectona)
मैंग्रोव जड़ें
आर्कटिक काई
कैक्टस
e:
Tropical deciduous forests (monsoon forests) India ka sabse widespread forest biome hain jo seasonal leaf shedding show karte hain.

• Option 1 is Correct because *Tectona grandis* (Teak / सागौन) Indian tropical moist aur dry deciduous forests ka dominant economically valuable climax tree species hai (alongside Sal, Mahua, Shisham, aur Palas).

• Option 2 is Incorrect because mangroves littoral/swamp coastal ecosystems me grow hote hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because mosses polar tundra regions me dominant hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because cacti arid desert ecosystems ke characteristic xerophytes hain.

qe: What term is used for detritivores like earthworms and dung beetles?
qh: केंचुए और गोबर के भृंग जैसे अपघटकों (detritivores) को और क्या कहा जाता है?
oe: Primary producers
Primary consumers
Tertiary predators
Sunlight fixers
oh: प्राथमिक उत्पादक
प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता (Primary consumers)
तृतीयक शिकारी
सूर्य के प्रकाश फिक्सर
e:
Detritus Food Chain (DFC) dead organic matter se initiate hoti hai jahan specialized organisms breakdown start karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because detritivores autotrophs nahi hote aur food synthesize nahi karte.

• Option 2 is Correct because earthworms, dung beetles, aur soil micro-arthropods direct dead organic detritus ko ingest karke nutrition derive karte hain, isliye Detritus Food Chain me inhe initial feeding level par 'Primary Consumers' classify kiya jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because tertiary predators living herbivores/carnivores hunt karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because detritivores me photosynthetic pigments absent hote hain.

qe: What is the consequence of natural disasters like floods on ecological succession?
qh: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रमण (ecological succession) पर बाढ़ जैसी प्राकृतिक आपदाओं का क्या परिणाम होता है?
oe: They permanently freeze the forest growth
They revert the community to an earlier stage of succession
They eliminate the need for sunlight
They turn rocks into pure gold
oh: वे वन विकास को स्थायी रूप से रोक देते हैं
वे समुदाय को अनुक्रमण के पहले के चरण में लौटा देते हैं
वे सूर्य के प्रकाश की आवश्यकता को समाप्त करते हैं
वे चट्टानों को शुद्ध सोने में बदल देते हैं
e:
Ecological succession natural and anthropogenic disturbances ke through disrupted ya redirected ho sakta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because disturbances forest growth ko permanently freeze nahi karte balki succession cycle restart kar dete hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because severe catastrophic disturbances jaise massive floods, forest fires, ya landslides existing mature vegetation ko destroy kar dete hain, jisse biological community apni current seral stage se revert hokar pehle ki kisi earlier/pioneer successional stage (secondary succession) me chali jati hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because recovering pioneer vegetation ko sunlight ki critical necessity rehti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because biological disturbances abiotic elemental composition ko gold me convert nahi kar sakte.

qe: What is the vertical stratification of a forest ecosystem?
qh: वन पारिस्थितिक तंत्र का ऊर्ध्वाधर स्तरीकरण (vertical stratification) क्या है?
oe: The random scattering of seeds by wind
The grouping of plants in defined layers based on their heights
The chemical composition of forest soil
The migration of birds every winter
oh: हवा द्वारा बीजों का यादृच्छिक प्रकीर्णन
पौधों को उनकी ऊंचाई के आधार पर परिभाषित परतों में समूहीकृत करना
जंगल की मिट्टी की रासायनिक संरचना
हर सर्दियों में पक्षियों का प्रवास
e:
Stratification forest ecosystem me sunlight aur space ke optimum utilization ke liye developed vertical architecture hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because seed dispersal wind propagation mechanics ka part hai, stratification ka nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because vertical stratification ka matlab plants aur trees ka unki physical height aur growth form ke according distinct vertical layers me arrangement hona hai (jaise ground floor herbs/grasses $\rightarrow$ intermediate shrubs $\rightarrow$ understory trees $\rightarrow$ top canopy layer).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because soil chemistry edaphic profile represent karti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because seasonal bird migration ethological behavioral pattern hai.

qe: Which organisms can occupy multiple trophic levels simultaneously?
qh: कौन से जीव एक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में एक से अधिक ट्रॉफिक स्तर (trophic level) पर कब्जा कर सकते हैं?
oe: Plants only
Humans and birds like sparrows
Only decomposers
Only sharks
oh: केवल पौधे
मनुष्य और गौरैया जैसे पक्षी
केवल अपघटक
केवल शार्क
e:
Trophic level kisi organism ki species identity nahi balki uske functional feeding relationship par depend karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because green plants strictly primary producer level ($T_1$) occupy karte hain.
