• Option 2 is Correct because omnivores jaise Humans aur birds (jaise Sparrows) jab seeds, fruits, ya grains khate hain toh wo Primary Consumers ($T_2$) act karte hain, par jab wo insects, worms, ya meat consume karte hain toh wo Secondary ($T_3$) ya Tertiary ($T_4$) consumers ban jate hain, occupying multiple levels simultaneously.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because decomposers Detritus food chain operate karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because sharks strictly carnivorous tiers par locate hoti hain.

qe: Why is secondary succession faster than primary succession?
qh: द्वितीयक अनुक्रमण (secondary succession) प्राथमिक अनुक्रमण की तुलना में तेज़ क्यों होता है?
oe: Because primary succession requires rocks to melt
Because soil/substratum is already present from previous inhabitants
Because plants grow faster in sunlight
Because the temperature is always cold
oh: क्योंकि प्राथमिक अनुक्रमण के लिए चट्टानों के पिघलने की आवश्यकता होती है
क्योंकि पिछले निवासियों की मिट्टी/सबस्ट्रेटम पहले से ही मौजूद है
क्योंकि पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश में तेजी से बढ़ते हैं
क्योंकि तापमान हमेशा ठंडा रहता है
e:
Succession speed substratum availability aur initial pedogenesis requirement par completely depend karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because primary succession rock weathering se shuru hota hai, melting se nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because secondary succession un areas me hoti hai jahan pehle se biotic community exist karti thi (e.g., abandoned farmlands, burnt forests); yahan well-formed soil, seed banks, aur underground vegetative propagules pehle se available hote hain, isliye soil formation ki slow stage bypass ho jati hai aur process fast hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because sunlight dono types ke succession me equally available hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because temperature regime succession category define nahi karta.

qe: What are pioneer species in a xeric succession?
qh: ज़ेरिक अनुक्रमण (xeric succession) में अग्रणी प्रजातियां (pioneer species) कौन सी होती हैं?
oe: Large oak trees
Lichens
Shrubs
Grasses
oh: बड़े ओक के पेड़
लाइकेन (Lichens)
घास
e:
Xerarch succession bare rocks ya extreme water-deficient dry substratum par establish hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because large trees terminal climax stages me aate hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because bare rock par xeric conditions me sabse pehle colonize karne wale pioneers crustose aur foliose Lichens hote hain; ye organic acids secrete karke rock weathering karte hain aur soil formation start karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because shrubs advanced seral stages me develop hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because grasses moss stage ke soil accumulation ke baad establish hoti hain.

qe: Is the common edible mushroom Agaricus an autotroph?
qh: क्या सामान्य खाने योग्य मशरूम, अगरिकस (Agaricus), एक स्वपोषी (autotroph) है?
oe: Yes, it uses light to make food
No, it is a chlorophyll-lacking heterotroph
Yes, it is a blue-green alga
No, it lives in deep space
oh: हाँ, यह भोजन बनाने के लिए प्रकाश का उपयोग करता है
नहीं, यह क्लोरोफिल-रहित परपोषी (heterotroph) है
हाँ, यह एक नीला-हरा शैवाल है
नहीं, यह गहरे अंतरिक्ष में रहता है
e:
Nutritional status photosynthetic pigment presence aur carbon assimilation pathway se define hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because mushrooms me photosynthetic light harvesting mechanism absent hota hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because *Agaricus* ek basidiomycete fungus hai jisme chlorophyll completely absent hota hai; ye photosynthesis ke zariye apna food synthesize nahi kar sakta aur nutrition ke liye decaying organic compost par dependent saprotrophic heterotroph hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because *Agaricus* fungus hai, cyanobacterium (blue-green alga) nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because mushrooms terrestrial decomposer habitats me reside karte hain.

qe: What are the two major types of ecological pyramids?
qh: पारिस्थितिक पिरामिडों के दो प्रमुख प्रकार क्या हैं?
oe: Upright and inverted
Hot and cold
Solid and liquid
Square and circular
oh: सीधा और उल्टा (Upright and inverted)
गर्म और ठंडा
ठोस और तरल
वर्गाकार और गोलाकार
e:
Ecological pyramids trophic parameters (numbers, biomass, energy) ko graphical geometric orientation me plot karte hain.

• Option 1 is Correct because trophic data distribution ke adhar par ecological pyramids do structural shapes manifest karte hain: Upright (jahan base broad aur apex narrow hota hai, jaise grassland biomass) aur Inverted (jahan base narrow aur apex broad hota hai, jaise aquatic biomass pyramid ya parasite tree number pyramid).

• Option 2 is Incorrect because thermal states ecological pyramid classification basis nahi hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because physical matter phases pyramid shapes define nahi karte.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 2D geometric cross-sections standardized ecological terminology nahi hain.

qe: Why are lichens considered pioneers in xeric succession?
qh: लाइकेन को ज़ेरिक अनुक्रमण में अग्रणी (pioneers) क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: Because they grow in water
Because they produce acids that corrode rock to form soil
Because they eat insects
Because they only grow on trees
oh: क्योंकि वे पानी में उगते हैं
क्योंकि वे एसिड का उत्पादन करते हैं जो मिट्टी बनाने के लिए चट्टान को संक्षारित करते हैं
क्योंकि वे कीड़ों को खाते हैं
क्योंकि वे केवल पेड़ों पर उगते हैं
e:
Pioneer species bare unweathered rocks par extreme environmental desiccation tolerate karne ke liye specialized hoti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because aquatic succession me phytoplankton pioneers hote hain, lichens nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because lichens specialized organic acids (lichen acids aur carbonic acid) secrete karte hain jo barren rock surface ko chemically weather aur corrode karke disintegrate karte hain, jisse primitive soil dust form hoti hai jo subsequent bryophytes ke colonization ko enable karti hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because lichens symbiotic autotrophic associations hain, insectivorous nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because saxicolous lichens specifically bare rocks par grow karte hain.

qe: What is the ultimate source of energy for almost all ecosystems?
qh: लगभग सभी पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों के लिए ऊर्जा का अंतिम स्रोत (ultimate source) क्या है?
oe: Geothermal heat
Solar radiation
Nuclear fusion
Burning coal
oh: भूतापीय ऊष्मा
सौर विकिरण (Solar radiation)
परमाणु संलयन
कोयला जलाना
e:
Biosphere me primary thermodynamic energy entry point celestial radiation par based hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because geothermal energy exclusively deep-sea hydrothermal vent ecosystems me limited scale par primary driver banti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Earth ke lagbhag sabhi natural terrestrial aur aquatic ecosystems ke liye Solar Radiation ultimate energy source hai, jise autotrophic producers photosynthesis ke through chemical biomass me capture karke food webs me circulate karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because atomic nuclear reactions general biosphere energy cycles direct drive nahi karte.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because coal burning secondary anthropogenic energy form hai.

qe: How do herbivores benefit from secondary productivity?
qh: शाकाहारी जीव द्वितीयक उत्पादकता (secondary productivity) से कैसे लाभान्वित होते हैं?
oe: They make energy from rocks
They consume primary producer biomass to synthesize their own tissue
They perform photosynthesis
They absorb minerals from air
oh: वे चट्टानों से ऊर्जा बनाते हैं
वे अपने स्वयं के ऊतकों को संश्लेषित करने के लिए प्राथमिक उत्पादक बायोमास का उपभोग करते हैं
वे प्रकाश संश्लेषण करते हैं
वे हवा से खनिजों को अवशोषित करते हैं
e:
Herbivores ecosystem me autotrophic plants aur carnivorous trophic tiers ke beech energy bridge ka kaam karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because herbivores lithospheric rocks metabolize nahi kar sakte.

• Option 2 is Correct because herbivores autotrophs dwara banaye gaye plant biomass (primary productivity) ko ingest aur digest karte hain aur us assimilated chemical energy ko apne living somatic tissues aur new consumer biomass (secondary productivity) me convert karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because herbivores animals hote hain jinme photosynthetic chloroplasts absent hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because nutrients aerial absorption ke bajay ingestion se obtain hote hain.

qe: What defines a detritivore?
qh: डेट्रिटिवोर (detritivore) किसे कहते हैं?
oe: An organism that eats living prey
An organism that feeds on dead organic tissue, such as earthworms
A plant that performs photosynthesis
A virus that infects humans
oh: एक जीव जो जीवित शिकार को खाता है
एक जीव जो मृत कार्बनिक ऊतक पर फ़ीड करता है, जैसे कि केंचुए
एक पौधा जो प्रकाश संश्लेषण करता है
एक वायरस जो मनुष्यों को संक्रमित करता है
e:
Detritivores heterotrophic decomposer food web ke internal macro-feeders hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because living prey hunt karne wale organisms predators ya carnivores kehlate hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because detritivores wo organisms hain jo dead plant parts, decaying animal remains, aur fecal matter (detritus) ko physically ingest karke smaller fragments me breakdown karte hain (jaise Earthworms, Millipedes, aur Dung beetles).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because photosynthetic plants autotrophic producers hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because viruses obligate intracellular parasites hote hain, detritivores nahi.

qe: Why are nutrient cycles termed biogeochemical cycles?
qh: पोषक चक्रों (nutrient cycles) को जैव-भू-रासायनिक चक्र (biogeochemical cycles) क्यों कहा जाता है?
oe: Because they cycle in circles
Because nutrients move between living organisms (bio) and the abiotic environment (geo)
Because they involve only chemical salts
Because they involve only living organisms
oh: क्योंकि वे वृत्तों में चक्रित होते हैं
क्योंकि पोषक तत्व जीवित जीवों (जैव) और अजैविक पर्यावरण (भू) के बीच स्थानांतरित होते हैं
क्योंकि इनमें केवल रासायनिक लवण शामिल हैं
क्योंकि इनमें केवल जीवित जीव शामिल हैं
e:
Ecosystems me nutrients matter conservation follow karte hue constant dynamic exchange me rehte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because cyclic movement word ke etymological essence ko fully justify nahi karta.

• Option 2 is Correct because ye pathways chemical elements ke continuous exchange ko depict karte hain jo living biotic components ('bio') aur abiotic terrestrial/atmospheric/aquatic reservoirs ('geo') ke beech cyclic chemical pathways me circulate hote hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because inme non-salt organic polymers aur gaseous phases bhi shamil hoti hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because abiotic lithosphere, atmosphere, aur hydrosphere inka major reservoir hote hain.

qe: What are xerarch successions?
qh: ज़ेरार्क अनुक्रमण (xerarch successions) क्या हैं?
oe: Succession in wet areas
Succession starting in extremely dry conditions like deserts
Succession in the deep sea
Succession occurring in forests
oh: गीले क्षेत्रों में अनुक्रमण
रेगिस्तान जैसी अत्यधिक शुष्क परिस्थितियों में शुरू होने वाला अनुक्रमण
गहरे समुद्र में अनुक्रमण
जंगलों में होने वाला अनुक्रमण
e:
Ecological succession moisture availability ke initial habitat conditions ke basis par classify hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because wet/aquatic habitats me shuru hone wali succession ko Hydrarch succession kehte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Xerarch succession wo ecological progression hai jo extremely water-deficient, dry, xeric habitats me shuru hoti hai jaise bare rocks, sand dunes, ya arid deserts, aur gradually mesic climax ki taraf badhti hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because marine ocean systems aquatic hydrarch category me aate hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because existing forest me disturbance ke baad hone wali succession secondary succession hoti hai.

qe: What is self-sustainability in an ecosystem?
qh: पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में आत्मनिर्भरता (self-sustainability) क्या है?
oe: Relying on imported chemical fertilizers
The ability of an ecosystem to maintain its structural and functional balance independently
Only existing in a controlled glasshouse
Removing all consumers
oh: आयातित रासायनिक उर्वरकों पर निर्भर रहना
एक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र की संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक संतुलन को स्वतंत्र रूप से बनाए रखने की क्षमता
केवल एक नियंत्रित ग्लासहाउस में मौजूद होना
सभी उपभोक्ताओं को हटाना
e:
Natural ecosystems homeostatic feedback loops maintain karke dynamic equilibrium retain karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because artificial external subsidies self-sustainability ko invalidate karti hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because ecosystem ki self-sustainability uski wo intrinsic capability hai jisme wo constant solar energy capture, complete biological food webs, aur internal biogeochemical nutrient recycling ke through apna structural integrity aur functional balance independently maintain karta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because glasshouse artificial enclosed setup hota hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because consumers nutrient flow aur population control ke vital balance drivers hain.

qe: What is the common role of earthworms, mushrooms, and dung beetles?
qh: केंचुए, मशरूम और गोबर के भृंग की सामान्य भूमिका क्या है?
oe: They are all top predators
They are detritivores or decomposers
They are strictly autotrophs
They fix nitrogen
oh: वे सभी शीर्ष शिकारी हैं
वे डेट्रिटिवोर या अपघटक हैं
वे पूरी तरह से स्वपोषी हैं
वे नाइट्रोजन फिक्स करते हैं
e:
Decomposer food web me specialized organisms dead organic detritus ko process karke nutrient recycling facilitate karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because ye living active prey hunt nahi karte.

• Option 2 is Correct because Earthworms aur Dung beetles functional detritivores hain jo dead organic residues ingest aur fragment karte hain, jabki Mushrooms (saprotrophic fungi) extracellular breakdown karte hain; isliye teeno dead matter ko breakdown karke nutrients soil me return karne wale decomposers/detritivores hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because teeno heterotrophs hain jinme photosynthetic ability nahi hoti.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because nitrogen fixation specialized prokaryotes perform karte hain.

qe: Which ecosystem service involves the reduction of global warming threats?
qh: कौन सी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र सेवा ग्लोबल वार्मिंग (global warming) के खतरों को कम करने में मदद करती है?
oe: Soil erosion
Carbon storage
Eating all insects
Increasing air pollution
oh: मृदा अपरदन
कार्बन भंडारण (Carbon storage)
सभी कीड़ों को खाना
वायु प्रदूषण में वृद्धि
e:
Ecosystems atmospheric greenhouse gases balance karke planetary thermal regulation deliver karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because soil erosion ecosystem degradation effect hai, service nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because intact natural forests, peatlands, aur oceans massive global carbon sinks ki tarah function karte hain jo atmospheric $	ext{CO}_2$ ko biological biomass aur oceanic sinks me sequester aur store karke greenhouse effect aur global warming threats ko directly mitigate karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because insect predation local food web dynamic hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because air pollution anthropogenic degradation driver hai.

qe: Why does the available energy decrease significantly as it moves from one trophic level to the next?
qh: एक ट्रॉफिक स्तर से अगले ट्रॉफिक स्तर पर ऊर्जा स्थानांतरित होते समय उपलब्ध ऊर्जा में उल्लेखनीय कमी क्यों आती है?
oe: Because energy is converted into inert matter
Because of the 10% law, where 90% of energy is lost as heat during respiration and other vital activities
Because producers absorb all energy from the sun
Because energy travels in a reverse direction
oh: क्योंकि ऊर्जा निष्क्रिय पदार्थ में परिवर्तित हो जाती है
10% नियम के कारण, जहाँ श्वसन और अन्य महत्वपूर्ण गतिविधियों के दौरान 90% ऊर्जा ऊष्मा के रूप में नष्ट हो जाती है
क्योंकि उत्पादक सूर्य से सभी ऊर्जा को अवशोषित करते हैं
क्योंकि ऊर्जा विपरीत दिशा में यात्रा करती है
e:
Biological trophic transfers thermodynamic entropy laws aur cellular energy consumption dwara strictly constrain hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because energy matter me convert hokar inert nahi banti balki heat me radiate hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Lindeman's 10% law ke mutabiq consumed energy ka lagbhag 90% fraction cellular respiration, physiological maintenance, physical work, aur unassimilated excretion me consume hokar environmental heat ke form me dissipate ho jata hai, leaving only ~10% for next level biomass.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because producers incoming solar energy ka keval fraction capture karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because ecological energy flow strictly unidirectional hota hai, reverse nahi.

qe: What is the primary reason why food chains in ecosystems are rarely longer than 4-5 trophic levels?
qh: पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में खाद्य श्रृंखलाएं (food chains) आमतौर पर 4-5 ट्रॉफिक स्तरों से अधिक लंबी क्यों नहीं होती हैं?
oe: Because there are not enough predators in nature
Because the residual energy decreases to an extent that it cannot support further trophic levels
Because plants grow too fast for consumers
Because decomposers do not allow longer chains
oh: क्योंकि प्रकृति में पर्याप्त शिकारी नहीं हैं
क्योंकि अवशिष्ट ऊर्जा इस हद तक कम हो जाती है कि यह आगे के ट्रॉफिक स्तरों का समर्थन नहीं कर सकती
क्योंकि पौधे उपभोक्ताओं के लिए बहुत तेजी से बढ़ते हैं
क्योंकि अपघटक लंबी श्रृंखलाओं की अनुमति नहीं देते हैं
e:
Trophic chain length available energy flux aur thermodynamic efficiency par directly dependent hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because predator diversity energy availability ka consequence hai, primary limiting cause nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because har successive trophic level transfer par 90% energy metabolic heat ke roop me lost ho jati hai; 4-5 steps ke baad residual energy itni negligible reh jati hai ki wo kisi further higher trophic tier ke population aur biomass ko metabolically sustain nahi kar sakti.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because plant productivity food chain length restrict nahi karti.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because decomposers har level ke dead biomass par parallel operate karte hain.

qe: Why is an aquarium considered a 'complete' man-made ecosystem?
qh: एक्वेरियम (aquarium) को एक 'पूर्ण' मानव-निर्मित पारिस्थितिक तंत्र क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: Because it contains both biotic components (fishes, plants) and necessary abiotic components (water, air) for survival
Because it is kept in a laboratory environment
Because it produces its own light energy
Because it does not require any oxygen
oh: क्योंकि इसमें जीवित रहने के लिए जैविक घटक (मछलियाँ, पौधे) और आवश्यक अजैविक घटक (पानी, हवा) दोनों शामिल हैं
क्योंकि इसे प्रयोगशाला के माहौल में रखा गया है
क्योंकि यह अपनी स्वयं की प्रकाश ऊर्जा का उत्पादन करता है
क्योंकि इसमें किसी ऑक्सीजन की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है
e:
Ecosystem ki structural definition biotic communities aur unke physical abiotic environment ke functional interaction par based hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because ek aquarium me essential biotic components (aquatic plants as producers, fishes as consumers, microbes as decomposers) aur supporting abiotic matrix (water, dissolved oxygen, nutrients, substrate) simultaneously present hote hain jo biological survival aur energy exchange execute karte hain, making it a complete artificial ecosystem.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because laboratory placement ecosystem completeness decide nahi karti.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because aquariums me light external input se aati hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because aquatic respiration ke liye dissolved oxygen fundamental requirement hai.

qe: Why is the decomposition rate in tropical rainforests significantly faster than in temperate or polar regions?
qh: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावनों (tropical rainforests) में अपघटन की दर शीतोष्ण या ध्रुवीय क्षेत्रों की तुलना में इतनी तेज क्यों होती है?
oe: Because tropical plants are made of plastic
Because high temperature and moisture (humidity) create favorable conditions for intense microbial activity
Because the soil is devoid of minerals
Because tropical insects eat everything instantly
oh: क्योंकि उष्णकटिबंधीय पौधे प्लास्टिक से बने होते हैं
क्योंकि उच्च तापमान और नमी (आर्द्रता) तीव्र सूक्ष्मजीवी गतिविधि के लिए अनुकूल परिस्थितियां बनाती हैं
क्योंकि मिट्टी खनिजों से रहित है
क्योंकि उष्णकटिबंधीय कीड़े तुरंत सब कुछ खा जाते हैं
e:
Decomposition rate microflora enzyme kinetics aur soil microclimate par directly govern hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because plant tissues natural cellulose, hemicellulose, aur lignin se bane hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because tropical rainforests me year-round high ambient temperatures aur excessive atmospheric humidity soil saprotrophs (bacteria, fungi, actinomycetes) ke enzymatic activity aur cellular proliferation ko maximize karte hain, jisse organic matter decomposition temperate ya frozen polar regions ke comparison me extremely fast hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because soil mineral status microbial enzyme acceleration ka primary thermal reason nahi hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because micro-insects detritus breakdown initiate karte hain par terminal decomposition microbial enzymes se hoti hai.

qe: What role do fossil fuel combustion and deforestation play in the global carbon cycle?
qh: वैश्विक कार्बन चक्र (carbon cycle) में जीवाश्म ईंधन के दहन और वनों की कटाई की क्या भूमिका है?
oe: They increase the rate of photosynthesis
They interfere with the cycle by releasing excess $	ext{CO}_2$ and removing carbon sinks
They help in cooling the earth
They have no impact on the carbon cycle
oh: वे प्रकाश संश्लेषण की दर को बढ़ाते हैं
वे अतिरिक्त $	ext{CO}_2$ जारी करके और कार्बन सिंक को हटाकर चक्र में हस्तक्षेप करते हैं
वे पृथ्वी को ठंडा करने में मदद करते हैं
कार्बन चक्र पर उनका कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता है
e:
Global carbon cycle terrestrial biological sinks, oceans, aur atmospheric greenhouse gas concentration ke balance par maintain rehta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because deforestation plant biomass destroy karti hai, overall photosynthesis capacity badhati nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because fossil fuels jalane se millions of years se locked lithospheric carbon rapid rate par $	ext{CO}_2$ bankar atmosphere me pump hota hai, aur simultaneous deforestation primary terrestrial photosynthetic carbon sinks ko eliminate kar deti hai, causing major atmospheric carbon budget imbalance.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because excess $	ext{CO}_2$ greenhouse heat trap karke global warming cause karti hai, cooling nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because anthropogenic emissions global carbon flux ke major driving factors hain.

qe: Why is the flow of energy in an ecosystem described as unidirectional?
qh: पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में ऊर्जा का प्रवाह (flow of energy) एकदिशीय (unidirectional) क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: Because energy can be created by carnivores
Because energy decreases at each trophic level and cannot be passed back to the previous level
Because the sun is a secondary source of energy
Because energy is converted into soil
oh: क्योंकि मांसाहारी जीवों द्वारा ऊर्जा का निर्माण किया जा सकता है
क्योंकि प्रत्येक पोषी स्तर पर ऊर्जा घटती है और इसे पिछले स्तर पर वापस नहीं भेजा जा सकता है
क्योंकि सूर्य ऊर्जा का द्वितीयक स्रोत है
क्योंकि ऊर्जा मिट्टी में परिवर्तित हो जाती है
e:
Trophic energy flow First aur Second Laws of Thermodynamics ke physical laws par operate karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because carnivores energy create nahi karte balki ingested biomass assimilate karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because solar energy sun se producers me aati hai aur sequential consumer levels ($T_1 ightarrow T_2 ightarrow T_3$) me move karti hai; har stage par lost heat energy wapas biological capture ke liye reverse direction me nahi ja sakti aur higher trophic tiers apni energy wapas lower autotrophs ko supply nahi kar sakte, making energy flow strictly unidirectional.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because sun solar radiation ka primary universal source hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because energy nutrients ki tarah soil me consolidate nahi hoti balki heat bankar radiate hoti hai.

qe: How do saprotrophic microbes fulfill their energy needs?
qh: मृतोपजीवी सूक्ष्मजीव (saprotrophic microbes) अपनी ऊर्जा आवश्यकताओं को कैसे पूरा करते हैं?
oe: By hunting live prey
By deriving nourishment from dead organic matter through extracellular digestion
By absorbing minerals from sunlight directly
By living as obligate parasites inside a host
oh: जीवित शिकार का शिकार करके
बाह्यकोशिकीय पाचन के माध्यम से मृत कार्बनिक पदार्थों से पोषण प्राप्त करके
सीधे सूर्य के प्रकाश से खनिजों को अवशोषित करके
एक मेजबान के अंदर बाध्यकारी परजीवी के रूप में रहकर
e:
Saprotrophs absorptive heterotrophic mode of nutrition follow karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because live predation carnivorous animals ka characteristic hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because saprotrophic fungi aur bacteria dead plant aur animal tissues par hydrolytic extracellular digestive enzymes secrete karte hain, jo complex insoluble organic polymers ko simple absorbable monomers me convert kar dete hain jise wo directly absorb karke metabolic energy obtain karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because minerals solar radiation me exist nahi karte aur non-photosynthetic microbes light capture nahi kar sakte.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because obligate parasites living host tissues par depend karte hain, dead substrates par nahi.

qe: Why is poaching tigers considered a threat to the entire forest ecosystem?
qh: बाघों का अवैध शिकार (poaching of tigers) पूरे वन पारिस्थितिक तंत्र के लिए खतरा क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: Because tigers are the only animals in the forest
Because as top carnivores, they keep the herbivore population in check, acting as an indicator of forest health
Because tigers produce oxygen for the trees
Because tigers are decomposers
oh: क्योंकि बाघ जंगल में एकमात्र जानवर हैं
क्योंकि शीर्ष मांसाहारी के रूप में वे शाकाहारी आबादी को नियंत्रण में रखते हैं और वन स्वास्थ्य के संकेतक के रूप में कार्य करते हैं
क्योंकि बाघ पेड़ों के लिए ऑक्सीजन का उत्पादन करते हैं
क्योंकि बाघ अपघटक हैं
e:
Apex predators ecosystem food webs me top-down trophic cascade regulation control karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because forests diverse multi-species communities host karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Tiger ek apex predator aur keystone umbrella species hai; agar tigers remove ho jayein toh herbivores (deer, wild boars) ki unchecked population explosion forest floor vegetation ko overgraze karke destroy kar degi, jisse entire forest community ka trophic balance collapse ho jayega.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because oxygen photosynthetic plants produce karte hain, mammals nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because tigers top carnivores hain, saprotrophic decomposers nahi.

qe: What explains the statement: '10 kg of deer meat is equivalent to 1 kg of lion's flesh'?
qh: इस कथन का क्या अर्थ है: '10 किलो हिरण का मांस 1 किलो शेर के मांस के बराबर है'?
oe: Because lions are heavier than deer
Because of the 10% energy transfer law in food chains
Because deer eat more than lions
Because lion meat is healthier
oh: क्योंकि शेर हिरण से भारी होते हैं
खाद्य श्रृंखलाओं में 10% ऊर्जा स्थानांतरण नियम के कारण
क्योंकि हिरण शेरों से ज्यादा खाते हैं
क्योंकि शेर का मांस स्वास्थ्यवर्धक होता है
e:
Trophic biomass conversion consecutive levels par ecological energy efficiency ratio se operate karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because individual body weights trophic conversion ratio ko govern nahi karte.

• Option 2 is Correct because Lindeman's 10% ecological efficiency law ke mutabiq lower trophic level (Herbivore/Deer) ke biomass ka lagbhag 10% hi next trophic tier (Carnivore/Lion) ke new somatic biomass me convert ho pata hai, jabki remaining 90% metabolic respiration me lost ho jata hai; isliye 10 kg deer biomass se approximately 1 kg lion biomass synthesize hota hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because daily dietary intake mass conversion efficiency ko directly explain nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because nutritional preferences ecological trophic scaling ka reason nahi hain.

qe: Why does primary productivity show variability across different ecosystems?
qh: प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (primary productivity) अलग-अलग पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों में भिन्न क्यों होती है?
oe: Because of the number of humans in the area
Because it depends on the availability of producers, plant species, nutrients, and environmental conditions
Because the sun shines differently in different places
Because plants can switch to carnivory
oh: क्षेत्र में मनुष्यों की संख्या के कारण
क्योंकि यह उत्पादकों, पौधों की प्रजातियों, पोषक तत्वों और पर्यावरणीय परिस्थितियों की उपलब्धता पर निर्भर करता है
क्योंकि अलग-अलग जगहों पर सूरज अलग तरह से चमकता है
क्योंकि पौधे मांसाहार में बदल सकते हैं
e:
Primary productivity autotrophic carbon fixation rate ko measure karti hai jo spatial aur biological parameters par depend karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because human population natural baseline productivity variation ka primary biological parameter nahi hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because primary productivity region-specific environmental drivers (solar radiation intensity, temperature, moisture availability, soil nutrient status) aur wahan inhabit karne wali plant species ki photosynthetic efficiency aur standing crop density par directly depend karti hai, causing high spatial variability.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because solar irradiance sirf ek component hai, whole biological limitation ko explain nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because insectivorous plants exceptions hain, general global productivity driver nahi.

qe: Can a climax community revert to an earlier seral stage?
qh: क्या एक चरम समुदाय (climax community) किसी प्रारंभिक चरण (seral stage) में वापस जा सकता है?
oe: No, succession is always permanent
Yes, due to natural disasters like fire, floods, or human-led destruction
Yes, if the sun turns blue
No, because trees are immortal
oh: नहीं, अनुक्रमण हमेशा स्थायी होता है
हाँ, आग, बाढ़ जैसी प्राकृतिक आपदाओं या मानव निर्मित विनाश के कारण
हाँ, अगर सूरज नीला हो जाए
नहीं, क्योंकि पेड़ अमर हैं
e:
Climax communities resilient equilibrium maintain karti hain par severe external ecological disturbances se vulnerable hoti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because ecological succession irreversibly static process nahi hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because catastrophic disturbances jaise wildfires, severe floods, landslides, volcanic eruptions, ya massive anthropogenic deforestation existing mature climax community ko wipe out kar dete hain, jisse ecosystem reset hokar earlier seral stages me revert ho jata hai (secondary succession).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because celestial color changes biological disturbance mechanics ka criteria nahi hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because trees mortal biological entities hain.

qe: Why are the profundal and benthic zones sometimes called an 'incomplete ecosystem'?
qh: प्रोफंडल और बेंथिक क्षेत्रों (profundal and benthic zones) को कभी-कभी 'अधूरा पारिस्थितिक तंत्र' (incomplete ecosystem) क्यों कहा जाता है?
oe: Because they are full of trash
Because they lack essential components like sunlight (producers), limiting independent energy production
Because they are found only in artificial tanks
Because they have no water
oh: क्योंकि वे कचरे से भरे हैं
क्योंकि उनमें सूर्य के प्रकाश (उत्पादकों) जैसे आवश्यक घटकों की कमी होती है, जो स्वतंत्र ऊर्जा उत्पादन को सीमित करते हैं
क्योंकि वे केवल कृत्रिम टैंकों में पाए जाते हैं
क्योंकि उनके पास पानी नहीं है
e:
Complete ecosystem autotrophic energy generation, consumer consumption, aur nutrient decomposition ke independent loop par define hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because anthropomorphic waste deep aquatic ecosystem structure ka defining ecological reason nahi hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because profundal aur deep benthic zones aphotic hote hain jahan solar sunlight reach nahi karti; photosynthetic producers absent hone ke karan ye zones independently energy fix nahi kar sakte aur upper photic layers se gir rahe organic detritus par completely depend karte hain, making them functionally incomplete.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because ye deep natural lakes aur oceans ke standard zones hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because deep aquatic layers water-saturated hoti hain.

qe: What is the primary shortcoming of using ecological pyramids to study complex natural food webs?
qh: जटिल खाद्य जालों (complex food webs) के अध्ययन के लिए पारिस्थितिक पिरामिडों का उपयोग करने में मुख्य कमी क्या है?
oe: They are too small to see
They assume a simple food chain and ignore food webs and decomposers
They show energy going backwards
They only work for forest trees
oh: वे देखने के लिए बहुत छोटे हैं
वे एक सरल खाद्य श्रृंखला मानते हैं और खाद्य जालों और अपघटकों की उपेक्षा करते हैं
वे ऊर्जा को पीछे जाते हुए दिखाते हैं
वे केवल जंगल के पेड़ों के लिए काम करते हैं
e:
Ecological pyramids abstract mathematical models hain jo complex real-world trophic dynamics ko oversimplify karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because ecological pyramids graphical diagrams hote hain, microscopic physical objects nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because ecological pyramids strictly linear, simple food chains assume karte hain jabki nature me complex multi-trophic interconnected food webs hoti hain; iske alawa pyramids me saprotrophs/decomposers (jo ecosystem functioning ke core pillar hain) ko koi distinct positional place allocate nahi kiya jata.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because pyramids energy flow unidirectional show karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because pyramids sabhi terrestrial aur aquatic biomes par theoretically plot kiye jaate hain.

qe: What is the difference between humification and mineralization?
qh: ह्यूमीकरण (humification) और खनिजीकरण (mineralization) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
oe: Humification is fast; Mineralization is slow
Humification builds complex resistant humus; Mineralization degrades humus to release inorganic nutrients
Humification happens in the air; Mineralization happens in the water
There is no difference
oh: ह्यूमीकरण तीव्र है; खनिजीकरण धीमा है
ह्यूमीकरण जटिल प्रतिरोधी ह्यूमस का निर्माण करता है; खनिजीकरण अकार्बनिक पोषक तत्वों को मुक्त करने के लिए ह्यूमस को विघटित करता है
ह्यूमीकरण हवा में होता है; खनिजीकरण पानी में होता है
कोई अंतर नहीं है
e:
Decomposition ek stepwise biological process hai jisme organic detritus pehle colloidal humus me convert hota hai aur phir inorganic minerals me degrade hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because humification aur mineralization dono slow microbiological processes hain, par inka primary difference reaction rate nahi balki unka biochemical product hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because humification me detritus dark, amorphous, colloidal organic mass (humus) me convert hota hai jo microbial action ke liye highly resistant hota hai; jabki mineralization me specialized microbes usi humus ko further break down karke simple inorganic mineral nutrients ($	ext{K}^+$, $	ext{Ca}^{2+}$, $	ext{Mg}^{2+}$, $	ext{CO}_2$, $	ext{H}_2	ext{O}$) soil me release karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because ye dono sequential processes soil matrix ke andar operate karte hain, atmosphere ya open water me isolated nahi hote.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because humification organic synthesis/accumulation phase hai jabki mineralization terminal inorganic release phase hai.

qe: Why are temperate and alpine biomes less productive than tropical forests regarding microbial decomposition?
qh: शीतोष्ण और अल्पाइन बायोम (temperate and alpine biomes) उष्णकटिबंधीय वनों की तुलना में सूक्ष्मजीव अपघटन के लिए कम उत्पादक क्यों हैं?
oe: Because the soil is too rich in phosphorus
Because cold temperatures and low moisture slow down the enzymatic activity of decomposers
Because there are no plants
Because the animals eat the microbes
oh: क्योंकि मिट्टी फास्फोरस से बहुत समृद्ध है
क्योंकि ठंडा तापमान और कम नमी अपघटकों की एंजाइमी गतिविधि को धीमा कर देती है
क्योंकि वहां कोई पौधे नहीं हैं
क्योंकि जानवर रोगाणुओं को खाते हैं
e:
Microbial decomposition kinetics temperature aur moisture dependent enzymatic hydrolysis par regulate hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because high phosphorus soil fertility badhata hai aur microbial growth ko support karta hai, retard nahi karta.

• Option 2 is Correct because temperate aur alpine biomes me persistent cold temperatures aur freezing/low moisture regimes saprotrophic bacteria aur fungi ki cellular enzymatic machinery ko inactivate ya drastically slow down kar dete hain, jisse detritus decomposition rate tropical biomes ke comparison me bohot kam ho jati hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because temperate aur alpine biomes me specialized coniferous trees, shrubs, aur alpine meadows abundant hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because microbial decomposition rate microclimate temperature se control hoti hai, predation se nahi.

qe: Which ecosystem service involves the purification of air and water?
qh: कौन सी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र सेवा हवा और पानी को शुद्ध करने में मदद करती है?
oe: Only the creation of desert dunes
Natural ecosystem purification and filtration services
Burning fossil fuels
Removing all birds
oh: केवल रेगिस्तानी टीलों का निर्माण
प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र शुद्धिकरण और निस्पंदन सेवाएं
जीवाश्म ईंधन जलाना
सभी पक्षियों को हटाना
e:
Ecosystem services intact natural biomes dwara society ko provide kiye jaane wale supporting, regulating, aur provisioning ecological benefits hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because sand dune formation physical aeolian geological process hai, primary water/air filtration service nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because natural ecosystems jaise intact forests (jo pollutants trap karke oxygen release karte hain) aur wetlands (jo toxic effluents aur suspended solids ko filter karke bio-remediation karte hain) biosphere me air aur water purification ki indispensable regulating services execute karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because fossil fuel combustion harmful particulate matter aur greenhouse gases emit karke pollution cause karta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because birds ko eliminate karna food chains ko disrupt karta hai aur ecosystem health ko degrade karta hai.

qe: What is an Edaphic factor?
qh: मृदीय कारक (edaphic factor) क्या है?
oe: Factors related to the atmosphere
Factors related to soil properties like texture, pH, and minerals
Factors related to solar light intensity
Factors related to seasonal wind speed
oh: वायुमंडल से संबंधित कारक
मिट्टी के गुणों जैसे बनावट, पीएच और खनिजों से संबंधित कारक
सौर प्रकाश की तीव्रता से संबंधित कारक
मौसमी हवा की गति से संबंधित कारक
e:
Abiotic ecological factors do major categories me split hote hain: atmospheric climatic factors aur substratum edaphic factors.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because atmospheric variables (temperature, air pressure) climatic factors kehlate hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because edaphic factors specifically substratum aur soil matrix ki physical aur chemical characteristics se relate karte hain—jaise soil texture, porosity, moisture-holding capacity, mineral concentration, topography, aur soil pH, jo vegetation patterns ko strongly determine karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because solar light intensity aur photoperiod light-climatic drivers hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because wind speed anemological climatic factor hai.

qe: What is an omnivore that plays a role in both the grazing and detritus food chains?
qh: वह कौन सा सर्वाहारी (omnivore) है जो चराई खाद्य श्रृंखला और अपघटक खाद्य श्रृंखला दोनों में भूमिका निभाता है?
oe: A lion
Cockroach or Crow
A snake
A phytoplankton
oh: एक शेर
कॉकरोच या कौआ
एक सांप
एक पादपप्लवक
e:
Omnivorous species broad dietary plasticity exhibit karti hain, jisse wo Grazing Food Chain (GFC) aur Detritus Food Chain (DFC) ke beech operational link ban jati hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because lion strictly apex obligate carnivore hai jo live grazing herbivores hunt karta hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Cockroaches aur Crows omnivorous generalists hain; ye living plant grains/insects (GFC) consume karne ke sath-sath decaying organic detritus, dead animal flesh, aur garbage (DFC) par feed karte hain, linking both food chains.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because snakes strictly carnivorous predators hote hain jo live prey consume karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because phytoplankton autotrophic primary producers hote hain.

qe: Why is the pitcher plant (Nepenthes) considered both a producer and a heterotroph?
qh: पिचर प्लांट (Nepenthes) को उत्पादक और परपोषी (heterotroph) दोनों क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: It makes food from iron
It is chlorophyllous (producer) but traps insects to meet nitrogen deficiency (heterotroph)
It is an artificial plant
It does not exist in nature
oh: यह लोहे से भोजन बनाता है
यह क्लोरोफिलयुक्त (उत्पादक) है लेकिन नाइट्रोजन की कमी को पूरा करने के लिए कीड़ों को फंसाता है (परपोषी)
यह एक कृत्रिम पौधा है
यह प्रकृति में मौजूद नहीं है
e:
Insectivorous plants unique mixotrophic nutrition adopt karte hain jahan carbon energy solar photosynthesis se aati hai par mineral deficit carnivory se poora hota hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because plants iron oxidation se organic sugars synthesize nahi karte.

• Option 2 is Correct because Nepenthes (Pitcher plant) green leaves me chlorophyll possess karta hai aur normal photosynthetic carbon fixation karta hai (autotrophic producer); lekin nitrogen-deficient, acidic soils me grow karne ke karan ye insects trap aur digest karke organic nitrogen absorb karta hai (heterotrophic trait).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because pitcher plant ek naturally evolved botanical genus hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Nepenthes species tropical rainforest ecosystems me naturally flourish karti hain.

qe: What characterizes a food chain in an aquatic ecosystem regarding the placement of large fish?
qh: जलीय पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में बड़ी मछलियों की स्थिति के संदर्भ में खाद्य श्रृंखला की क्या विशेषता है?
oe: They are always primary producers
They are usually tertiary consumers (secondary carnivores)
They eat rocks
They produce their own light
oh: वे हमेशा प्राथमिक उत्पादक होते हैं
वे आमतौर पर तृतीयक उपभोक्ता (द्वितीयक मांसाहारी) होते हैं
वे चट्टानें खाते हैं
वे अपना प्रकाश स्वयं उत्पन्न करते हैं
e:
Aquatic grazing trophic chains standard size-based predatory hierarchies follow karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because primary producers microscopic phytoplankton aur aquatic macrophytes hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because standard aquatic grazing chain me sequence hoti hai: Phytoplankton (Producers, $T_1$) $ightarrow$ Zooplankton (Primary Consumers, $T_2$) $ightarrow$ Small fish (Secondary Consumers / Primary Carnivores, $T_3$) $ightarrow$ Large fish (Tertiary Consumers / Secondary Carnivores, $T_4$).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because fish biological living tissues par feed karti hain, lithic rocks par nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because bioluminescence deep-sea communication/predation adaptation hai, trophic position determinant nahi.

qe: Why does the number of trophic levels stay limited in any ecosystem?
qh: किसी भी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में ट्रॉफिक स्तरों (trophic levels) की संख्या सीमित क्यों रहती है?
oe: Because animals get tired of eating
Because energy availability decreases significantly at each successive trophic level
Because the sun is too far away
Because plants grow too slow
oh: क्योंकि जानवर खाते-खाते थक जाते हैं
क्योंकि प्रत्येक क्रमिक पोषी स्तर पर ऊर्जा की उपलब्धता में उल्लेखनीय कमी आती है
क्योंकि सूर्य बहुत दूर है
क्योंकि पौधे बहुत धीमी गति से बढ़ते हैं
e:
Ecosystem trophic structures Second Law of Thermodynamics aur Lindeman's 10% ecological efficiency rule dwara energetically capped hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because behavioral feeding fatigue trophic structure limits ko explain nahi karta.

• Option 2 is Correct because har successive trophic level transfer par lagbhag 90% energy cellular respiration, metabolic maintenance, aur heat dissipation ke roop me lost ho jati hai; 4th ya 5th level tak pahunchte-pahunchte residual energy itni negligible bachti hai ki wo kisi subsequent higher trophic population ko sustain nahi kar sakti.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because celestial distance constant astronomical parameter hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because high plant growth rates wale tropical forests me bhi trophic levels 4–5 tiers par hi terminate hote hain.

qe: Which organisms are primary consumers in the grassland ecosystem pyramid?
qh: घास के मैदान के पिरामिड (grassland ecosystem pyramid) में प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता कौन होते हैं?
oe: Lions
Herbivores
Producers
Decomposers
oh: शेर
शाकाहारी जीव (Herbivores)
उत्पादक
अपघटक
e:
Trophic tiers me organisms apne primary nutritional source ke according systematically positioned hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because lions top apex carnivores ($T_4$) hain jo other carnivores/herbivores par feed karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because grassland ecosystem me grasses ($T_1$) dwara synthesized primary biomass par directly graze karne wale herbivorous animals (jaise Grasshoppers, Deer, Rabbits, Cattle) Primary Consumers ($T_2$) act karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because producers ($T_1$) autotrophs hote hain jo photosynthesis execute karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because decomposers detritus food web me dead organic waste recycle karte hain.

qe: What is the ultimate source of energy for most deep-sea hydrothermal vent ecosystems?
qh: अधिकांश गहरे समुद्र के हाइड्रोथर्मल वेंट पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों (hydrothermal vent ecosystems) के लिए ऊर्जा का अंतिम स्रोत क्या है?
oe: Solar radiation
Chemosynthesis
Volcanic lava
Wind energy
oh: सौर विकिरण
रासायनिक संश्लेषण (Chemosynthesis)
ज्वालामुखीय लावा
पवन ऊर्जा
e:
Deep aphotic ocean floors par sunlight completely absent hone ke karan biological communities alternate chemical synthesis par depend karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because solar radiation abyssal depths (~2500m+) tak penetrate nahi kar sakti.

• Option 2 is Correct because hydrothermal vent ecosystems me primary producers specialized chemoautotrophic bacteria hote hain jo vent fluids se nikalne wale inorganic compounds (jaise $	ext{H}_2	ext{S}$, methane) ke chemical oxidation se energy harvest karke organic matter synthesize (chemosynthesis) karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because volcanic lava physical thermal heat supply karta hai par organic biomass synthesis direct chemical bond oxidation se hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because atmospheric wind surface ocean dynamics drive karti hai, deep-sea benthic floors nahi.

qe: Which organisms trap energy at the first trophic level in a grassland?
qh: घास के मैदान में पहले ट्रॉफिक स्तर पर ऊर्जा को कौन ग्रहण (trap) करता है?
oe: Carnivores
Green plants / Producers
Decomposers
Omnivores
oh: मांसाहारी
हरे पौधे / उत्पादक (Green plants / Producers)
अपघटक
सर्वाहारी
e:
Food chain ka fundamental baseline trophic level ($T_1$) autotrophic solar energy transduction par rely karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because carnivores higher trophic levels ($T_3/T_4$) occupy karte hain aur dusre animals ko consume karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because grassland ecosystem me green plants, grasses, aur herbs photosynthetic chlorophyll ke zariye incident solar radiation ko trap karke chemical organic bonds me fix karte hain, jisse wo First Trophic Level ($T_1$) form karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because decomposers non-photosynthetic heterotrophs hote hain jo dead detritus par depend karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because omnivores plant aur animal matter dono ingest karne wale consumer tiers hain.

qe: What is meant by the term '10% law' in ecological energetics?
qh: पारिस्थितिक ऊर्जा विज्ञान (ecological energetics) में '10% नियम' का क्या अर्थ है?
oe: 10% of energy is lost as light
Only 10% of the energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next
10% of energy is stored in rocks
The sun gives 10% of its total power
oh: 10% ऊर्जा प्रकाश के रूप में नष्ट हो जाती है
एक पोषी स्तर से अगले स्तर पर केवल 10% ऊर्जा स्थानांतरित होती है
10% ऊर्जा चट्टानों में संग्रहीत होती है
सूर्य अपनी कुल शक्ति का 10% देता है
e:
Raymond Lindeman (1942) ne trophic energy transfer efficiency quantify karne ke liye Ten Percent Law formulate kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because lost energy primarily thermal heat ke form me dissipate hoti hai, luminous light me nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because 10% law state karta hai ki kisi ek trophic level me enter hone wali total organic energy ka lagbhag 10% hi agle trophic tier ke living biomass ke roop me assimilate aur transfer ho pata hai, jabki 90% metabolic respiration, excretion, aur heat dissipation me lost ho jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because energy biological tissues me metabolize hoti hai, inorganic rocks me store nahi hoti.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because solar radiation output nuclear fusion laws par depend karta hai, ecological 10% law par nahi.

qe: Why are decomposers important for mineral recycling?
qh: खनिज पुनर्चक्रण (mineral recycling) के लिए अपघटक (decomposers) क्यों महत्वपूर्ण हैं?
oe: They eat live animals
They break down dead organic matter, releasing trapped inorganic minerals back to the environment
They produce plastics
They keep the air clean
oh: वे जीवित जानवरों को खाते हैं
वे मृत कार्बनिक पदार्थों को तोड़ते हैं, जिससे फंसे हुए अकार्बनिक खनिज पर्यावरण में वापस आ जाते हैं
वे प्लास्टिक का उत्पादन करते हैं
वे हवा को साफ रखते हैं
e:
Decomposers natural nutrient cycles ke terminal recyclers hote hain jo bound bio-elements ko abiotic soil pool me restore karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because live animals ko consume karna predators ka trait hai, decomposers ka nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because fungi aur bacteria dead plant litter aur animal carcasses ke complex organic structures ko hydrolytic enzymes se break down karte hain, jisse trapped inorganic minerals (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Calcium) wapas soil/water me release hote hain aur primary autotrophs unhe dobara absorb kar pate hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because synthetic plastics non-biodegradable anthropogenic compounds hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because general air cleanliness decomposers ka core physiological mineral recycling function nahi hai.

qe: What happens in a grazing food chain if a primary carnivore is removed?
qh: यदि एक चराई खाद्य श्रृंखला (grazing food chain) से प्राथमिक मांसाहारी को हटा दिया जाए, तो क्या होगा?
oe: The plants will die
Herbivores will overpopulate, potentially causing ecosystem imbalance
Sunlight will stop reaching the earth
Plants will stop growing
oh: पौधे मर जाएंगे
शाकाहारी जीवों की संख्या अत्यधिक बढ़ जाएगी, जिससे संभावित रूप से पारिस्थितिक असंतुलन पैदा होगा
सूर्य का प्रकाश पृथ्वी तक पहुंचना बंद हो जाएगा
पौधे बढ़ना बंद कर देंगे
e:
Trophic networks me predators top-down population regulation exert karke community stability maintain karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because plants directly nahi marte balki secondary consequence ke roop me overgrazing face karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because primary carnivores ($T_3$) herbivores ($T_2$) par feed karke unki population ko ecological carrying capacity ke andar restrict karte hain; agar inhe completely remove kar diya jaye toh herbivores ki population explode ho jayegi, resulting in severe overgrazing, habitat destruction, aur ultimate ecosystem collapse.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because celestial sunlight physical solar dynamics se govern hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because plants photosynthesis continue rakhte hain par overconsumption unhe deplete kar deta hai.

qe: What is the role of solar energy in the primary productivity of an ecosystem?
qh: किसी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र की प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (primary productivity) में सौर ऊर्जा की क्या भूमिका है?
oe: It heats the water
It is trapped by producers to convert into chemical energy via photosynthesis
It helps animals breathe
It acts as a decomposer
oh: यह पानी को गर्म करता है
यह प्रकाश संश्लेषण के माध्यम से रासायनिक ऊर्जा में बदलने के लिए उत्पादकों द्वारा ग्रहण की जाती है
यह जानवरों को सांस लेने में मदद करता है
यह एक अपघटक के रूप में कार्य करता है
e:
Primary productivity total rate of biological energy transduction ko measure karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because water heating thermodynamic physical effect hai, photosynthetic biomass synthesis nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because solar radiant energy (specifically 400–700 nm PAR band) ko autotrophic chlorophyll pigments capture karte hain aur photolysis/carbon reduction ke zariye high-energy chemical bonds (glucose/biomass) me convert karte hain, jo primary productivity ka baseline driver hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because cellular respiration oxygen exchange par operate karti hai, solar capture par nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because saprotrophs dead detritus consume karte hain, solar energy decompose nahi karti.

qe: How does soil texture influence an ecosystem?
qh: मिट्टी की बनावट (soil texture) एक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र को कैसे प्रभावित करती है?
oe: It controls how much sunlight plants get
It determines water holding capacity and mineral availability, acting as an edaphic factor
It has no impact on plants
It affects the color of flowers
oh: यह नियंत्रित करता है कि पौधों को कितना सूर्य का प्रकाश मिलता है
यह जल धारण क्षमता और खनिज उपलब्धता को निर्धारित करता है, जो एक मृदीय कारक के रूप में कार्य करता है
इसका पौधों पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता है
यह फूलों के रंग को प्रभावित करता है
e:
Soil texture sand, silt, aur clay particles ke relative proportions dwara defined edaphic master variable hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because canopy architecture aur ambient sunlight solar factors hain, soil texture se independent.

• Option 2 is Correct because soil texture soil aeration, capillary water-holding capacity, root penetration ease, aur mineral cation-exchange capacity ko fundamentally control karta hai, jo determine karta hai ki kaun si plant species wahan colonize aur thrive kar sakti hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because soil texture terrestrial plant composition ka foundational physical determinant hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because floral pigmentation genetic expressions aur anthocyanin chemistry se drive hoti hai.

qe: What is an 'inverted pyramid of numbers'?
qh: 'संख्याओं का उलटा पिरामिड' (inverted pyramid of numbers) क्या है?
oe: Where producers are many and consumers are few
A situation where a single producer supports many parasites or herbivores
Where energy is infinite
Where only grass grows
oh: जहाँ उत्पादक अनेक हैं और उपभोक्ता कम हैं
ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ एक अकेला उत्पादक कई परजीवियों या शाकाहारियों का पोषण करता है
जहाँ ऊर्जा अनंत है
जहाँ केवल घास उगती है
e:
Pyramid of numbers individual organisms ke absolute numerical count ko trophic levels ke across plot karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because broad producer base aur narrow consumer apex Upright Pyramid of numbers construct karta hai (jaise grassland me).

• Option 2 is Correct because inverted pyramid of numbers tab form hota hai jab producer level par numerical count bohot kam ho (jaise single large Oak/Banyan tree) par us par feed karne wale primary consumers (thousands of herbivorous insects/birds) aur unpar dependent hyper-parasites ki count progressively badhti jati hai, making the apex broader than the base.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because energy ecological systems me finite aur dissipative hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because grassland ecosystems strictly upright number pyramids form karte hain.

qe: What defines the 'climax community' stage in ecological succession?
qh: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रमण (ecological succession) में 'चरम समुदाय' (climax community) चरण किसे परिभाषित करता है?
oe: The first stage of growth
The stable, final biotic community that exists in harmony with the environment
A stage that changes every day
The stage caused only by fire
oh: विकास का पहला चरण
स्थिर, अंतिम जैविक समुदाय जो पर्यावरण के साथ सामंजस्य में मौजूद है
एक ऐसा चरण जो हर दिन बदलता है
वह चरण जो केवल आग से उत्पन्न होता है
e:
Ecological succession directional biological community progression ke terminal point par stabilize hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because succession ka initial colonizing phase Pioneer Stage kehlata hai (jaise lichens ya phytoplankton).

• Option 2 is Correct because climax community succession ka final, self-perpetuating, aur structurally complex biotic assemblage hai jo native regional macro-climate ke sath dynamic equilibrium aur maximum homeostasis maintain karta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because climax communities decades aur centuries tak stable species composition sustain karti hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because fire ecological disturbance agent hai jo succession ko reset karta hai, climax define nahi karta.

qe: Which organisms are responsible for the 'secondary productivity' in an ecosystem?
qh: पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में 'द्वितीयक उत्पादकता' (secondary productivity) के लिए कौन से जीव जिम्मेदार हैं?
oe: Plants
Herbivores and consumers
Decomposers
Sunlight rays
oh: पौधे
शाकाहारी और उपभोक्ता (Herbivores and consumers)
अपघटक
सूर्य की किरणें
e:
Secondary productivity heterotrophic levels par new organic biomass synthesis ki rate ko designate karti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because photosynthetic plants primary producers hote hain aur Primary Productivity (GPP/NPP) ke liye responsible hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Secondary Productivity ko consumers (Herbivores aur Carnivores) dwara food ingestion aur assimilation ke baad apne body mass me new organic tissue compile karne ki rate ke roop me define kiya jata hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because decomposers dead detritus ko catabolize karke inorganic minerals release karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because sunlight abiotic physical energy input hai.

qe: How do lichens facilitate the primary succession on a bare rock?
qh: लाइकेन (lichens) नंगी चट्टानों पर प्राथमिक अनुक्रमण (primary succession) को कैसे सुविधाजनक बनाते हैं?
oe: They eat rocks directly
By releasing acids that weather the rock into soil, providing a substrate for others
By blocking sunlight
By attracting birds
oh: वे सीधे चट्टानों को खाते हैं
एसिड जारी करके जो चट्टान को मिट्टी में बदल देते हैं, दूसरों के लिए एक सबस्ट्रेट प्रदान करते हैं
सूर्य के प्रकाश को अवरुद्ध करके
पक्षियों को आकर्षित करके
e:
Xerarch primary succession unweathered parent rock surfaces par pioneer biological establishment se initiate hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because lichens fungi aur algae ka symbiotic association hain jo holozoic ingestion nahi karte.

• Option 2 is Correct because crustose aur foliose lichens specialized organic acids (lichen acids, carbonic acid) secrete karte hain jo mineral rock substrate ko chemically corrode aur disintegrate karte hain; ye weathered rock dust aur decaying lichen organic residues milkar primitive soil layer form karte hain jo subsequent bryophytes aur mosses ke colonization ko enable karta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because sunlight blocking higher plant succession facilitate nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because pioneer pedogenesis biochemical weathering se execute hoti hai.

qe: What defines a 'food web'?
qh: 'खाद्य जाल' (food web) को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
oe: A linear chain of energy flow
An interconnected network of multiple overlapping food chains
A static system where organisms only eat one type of food
A diagram that shows only plants
oh: ऊर्जा प्रवाह की एक रैखिक श्रृंखला
कई परस्पर जुड़ी और अतिव्यापी खाद्य श्रृंखलाओं का एक नेटवर्क
एक स्थिर प्रणाली जहाँ जीव केवल एक ही प्रकार का भोजन खाते हैं
एक आरेख जो केवल पौधों को दिखाता है
e:
Natural ecosystems me feeding relationships linear chains ke bajay dynamic interconnected networks ke roop me exist karti hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because single unbranched energy flow ko simple Food Chain kehte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Food Web kisi biological community me present multiple interconnected aur overlapping grazing tatha detritus food chains ka comprehensive network hota hai, jisme organisms alternate feeding pathways choose karte hain, ensuring ecosystem resilience aur stability.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because specialized single-food dependency food webs ki functional elasticity ko contradict karti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because food web all trophic levels (producers, herbivores, carnivores, decomposers) ko comprehensively integrate karta hai.

qe: What happens if an ecosystem loses its decomposers?
qh: यदि किसी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र से अपघटक (decomposers) गायब हो जाएं तो क्या होगा?
oe: Energy transfer would increase
Dead organic matter would accumulate and nutrient cycling would stop
Plants would grow faster
The sun would stop shining
oh: ऊर्जा स्थानांतरण बढ़ जाएगा
मृत कार्बनिक पदार्थ जमा हो जाएंगे और पोषक चक्र रुक जाएगा
पौधे तेजी से बढ़ेंगे
सूरज चमकना बंद कर देगा
e:
Decomposers biosphere ke closed-loop nutrient cycle ke foundational driving agents hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because thermodynamic energy transfer rules decomposers ke absence me change nahi hote.

• Option 2 is Correct because saprotrophs (bacteria aur fungi) ke bina dead plant residues aur animal carcasses soil surface par indefinitely accumulate ho jayenge; critical inorganic minerals ($\text{N}$, $\text{P}$, $\text{K}$, $\text{Ca}$) organic detritus ke andar permanently lock ho jayenge jisse nutrient cycling completely halt ho jayegi aur autotrophs nutrient starvation se collapse ho jayenge.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because mineral availability zero hone par plant growth terminate ho jayegi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because solar radiation astronomical physics par operate karta hai.

qe: Why are forests sometimes considered 'carbon sinks'?
qh: वनों को कभी-कभी 'कार्बन सिंक' (carbon sinks) क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: They release more $\text{CO}_2$ than they absorb
They absorb significant amounts of carbon dioxide through photosynthesis
They are the source of all global warming
They create methane gas
oh: वे जितनी अवशोषित करते हैं उससे अधिक $\text{CO}_2$ छोड़ते हैं
वे प्रकाश संश्लेषण के माध्यम से महत्वपूर्ण मात्रा में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को अवशोषित करते हैं
वे सभी ग्लोबल वार्मिंग के स्रोत हैं
वे मीथेन गैस बनाते हैं
e:
Terrestrial forests planetary carbon sequestration aur atmospheric composition balance ke primary biological regulators hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because net carbon sinks absorption emissions se substantially zyada maintain karte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because mature forests Gross Primary Productivity ke dauran massive volumes of atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ absorb karte hain aur use long-lived woody tissues (trunks, branches, roots) aur forest soil humus me long-term solid organic carbon ke form me store karke rakhte hain, acting as major carbon sinks.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because forests global warming mitigate karte hain, cause nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because aerobic forest soils primarily $\text{CO}_2$ sink karte hain, anaerobic swamps ki tarah bulk methane source nahi bante.

qe: What is the importance of 'niche specialization' in a climax community?
qh: चरम समुदाय (climax community) में 'आला विशेषज्ञता' (niche specialization) का क्या महत्व है?
oe: It allows organisms to compete for the same resource
It promotes stability and maximum biodiversity by allowing species to coexist
It reduces the total biomass
It makes the ecosystem vulnerable
oh: यह जीवों को एक ही संसाधन के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करने की अनुमति देता है
यह प्रजातियों को सह-अस्तित्व की अनुमति देकर स्थिरता और अधिकतम जैव विविधता को बढ़ावा देता है
यह कुल बायोमास को कम करता है
यह पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को असुरक्षित बनाता है
e:
Ecological niche kisi species ke functional role, resource utilization pattern, aur structural position ko define karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because niche specialization direct inter-specific competition ko avoid karta hai, promote nahi karta.

• Option 2 is Correct because niche specialization (resource partitioning) ke through different species spatial micro-habitats, distinct food sizes, ya different foraging times utilize karti hain; isse Gause's competitive exclusion principle bypass ho jata hai aur high species diversity peacefully coexist karke climax community ko maximum stability aur resilience provide karti hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because optimized niche utilization ecosystem ke overall biomass yield ko maximize karta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because niche complexity ecosystem ko external shocks ke against highly resistant banati hai.

qe: What defines the benthic zone of a lake?
qh: झील का बेंथिक क्षेत्र (benthic zone) क्या है?
oe: The sunlit top layer
The bottom-most layer of the water body
The area near the surface
The floating plant zone
oh: सूर्य के प्रकाश वाली शीर्ष परत
जल निकाय की सबसे निचली परत (तलछट क्षेत्र)
सतह के पास का क्षेत्र
तैरता हुआ पौधा क्षेत्र
e:
Aquatic lentic habitats depth gradient aur substrate profile ke basis par distinct horizontal aur vertical zones me stratify hote hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because sunlit surface layer ko photic/epilimnion zone kehte hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Benthic Zone kisi lake, ocean, ya pond ka lowest ecological region hota hai, jisme bottom sediment surface (mud, silt, sand) aur sub-surface sediment layers shamil hoti hain jahan specialized benthos organisms aur decomposers inhabit karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because near-surface water pelagic/limnetic zone define karta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because floating hydrophytes shallow shoreline littoral zone me concentrate hote hain.

qe: Why are insects, earthworms, and dung beetles important in a detritus food chain?
qh: अपघटक खाद्य श्रृंखला (detritus food chain) में कीट, केंचुए और गोबर के भृंग महत्वपूर्ण क्यों हैं?
oe: They hunt small animals
They function as detritivores, breaking down complex dead matter into fragments
They fix nitrogen directly
They are primary producers
oh: वे छोटे जानवरों का शिकार करते हैं
वे डेट्रिटिवोर के रूप में कार्य करते हैं, जटिल मृत पदार्थों को टुकड़ों में तोड़ते हैं
वे सीधे नाइट्रोजन स्थिर करते हैं
वे प्राथमिक उत्पादक हैं
e:
Decomposition cascade me physical fragmentation microbial enzymatic hydrolysis ke liye compulsory prerequisite hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because live animal predation carnivorous grazing food chain ka domain hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Earthworms, Dung beetles, aur soil insects macro-detritivores act karte hain jo dead plant litter aur fecal residues ko physically chew aur pulverize (fragmentation) karte hain; is fragmentation se surface area exponentially increase hota hai, allowing saprotrophic bacteria aur fungi to enzymatically mineralize the matter rapidly.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because biological nitrogen fixation specialized prokaryotes (Rhizobium, Azotobacter) perform karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because detritivores non-photosynthetic heterotrophic consumers hote hain.

qe: Can an ecosystem be sustained without producers?
qh: क्या उत्पादकों (producers) के बिना पारिस्थितिक तंत्र बना रह सकता है?
oe: Yes, animals don't need food
No, producers are essential for energy fixation for all other trophic levels
Yes, they are replaceable
No, but only because they look nice
oh: हाँ, जानवरों को भोजन की आवश्यकता नहीं है
नहीं, उत्पादक अन्य सभी पोषी स्तरों के लिए ऊर्जा निर्धारण के लिए आवश्यक हैं
हाँ, वे प्रतिस्थापन योग्य हैं
नहीं, केवल इसलिए कि वे अच्छे दिखते हैं
e:
Biosphere me thermodynamic energy capture autotrophic biochemical machinery par completely anchor karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because all heterotrophic organisms require continuous chemical bond energy for metabolic cellular survival.

• Option 2 is Correct because Autotrophs (photoautotrophs aur chemoautotrophs) ecosystem ke sole biological gatekeepers hain jo abiotic environmental energy (sunlight ya chemical bonds) ko organic glucose/biomass me convert karte hain; unke bina energy food web me enter nahi kar sakti aur poora trophic pyramid collapse ho jayega.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because higher consumers energy fix karne me physiologically incapable hote hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because primary producers ki existence aesthetic preference par nahi balki functional trophic bioenergetics par mandatory hai.

qe: An agro-ecosystem like a wheat field behaves as an artificial ecosystem. Which of the following is an example of an abiotic component managed directly by a human inside a crop field?
qh: गेंहू के खेत जैसा एक कृषि-पारितंत्र (agro-ecosystem) एक कृत्रिम पारितंत्र के रूप में कार्य करता है। फसल के खेत के भीतर मानव द्वारा सीधे प्रबंधित अजैविक (abiotic) घटक का उदाहरण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
oe: Naturally supplied humidity
Controlled irrigation or water input
Atmospheric carbon dioxide
Ambient sunlight duration
oh: प्राकृतिक रूप से आपूर्ति की गई आर्द्रता
नियंत्रित सिंचाई या जल इनपुट
वायुमंडलीय कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड
परिवेशी सूर्य के प्रकाश की अवधि
e:
Agro-ecosystems man-made engineered habitats hote hain jahan abiotic aur biotic variables ko high crop yield ke liye artificially manipulate kiya jata hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because ambient atmospheric humidity regional macro-climatic weather pattern se regulate hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because farmer field conditions me water availability optimize karne ke liye canals, tube-wells, aur drip/sprinkler networks ke zariye controlled irrigation water aur artificial fertilizer nutrients provide karta hai, making it a directly managed abiotic input.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because open atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ concentration regional atmospheric gas envelope se govern hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because daylight photoperiod latitude aur seasonal earth rotation se control hoti hai.

qe: What percentage of the total incident solar radiation over the Earth's surface constitutes Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR)?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह पर कुल आपतित सौर विकिरण (incident solar radiation) का कितना प्रतिशत प्रकाश-संश्लेषक रूप से सक्रिय विकिरण (PAR) का हिस्सा होता है?
oe: Approximately 50%
Exactly 10%
Around 25%
More than 90%
oh: लगभग 50% (Approximately 50%)
बिल्कुल 10%
लगभग 25%
90% से अधिक
e:
Solar radiation spectrum UV, visible light, aur infrared wavelengths ka mixture hota hai jisme se specific band hi photosynthesis drive karta hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because Earth surface par fall hone wale total incident solar radiation me se roughly 50% spectral bandwidth 400 nm se 700 nm wavelength range me belong karti hai, jise Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) kehte hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because 10% trophic level energy transfer efficiency ka benchmark metric hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because visible PAR wavelength share 25% se significantly higher (nearly half) hota hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because infrared aur ultraviolet wavelengths total incoming radiation ka substantial fraction constitute karte hain.

qe: What percent of the incident Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) is actually captured and utilized by green plants to sustain the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP)?
qh: आपतित प्रकाश-संश्लेषक रूप से सक्रिय विकिरण (PAR) का कितना प्रतिशत वास्तव में हरे पौधों द्वारा सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) को बनाए रखने के लिए ग्रहण और उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: Exactly 1%
oh: बिल्कुल 1%
e:
Photosynthetic machinery incoming photons ko capture karke biochemical energy me convert karne me specific biological limits follow karti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because autotrophic plants available Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) ka keval 2–10% fraction (jo total incident solar radiation ka ~1–5% banta hai) harvest karke Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) ke roop me organic molecules synthesize kar pate hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because 20–30% conversion efficiency physiological photo-inhibition aur optical reflection losses ke karan biological systems me achieve nahi hoti.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 1% metric minimum boundary threshold reflect karta hai, standard functional range 2–10% of PAR hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 50% total solar spectrum me se available PAR ka proportion hai, plant utilization rate nahi.

qe: The total rate of organic matter production generated by producers during photosynthesis in a given unit area is scientifically termed as:
qh: किसी दिए गए इकाई क्षेत्र में प्रकाश संश्लेषण के दौरान उत्पादकों द्वारा कार्बनिक पदार्थों के उत्पादन की कुल दर को वैज्ञानिक रूप से क्या कहा जाता है?
oe: Gross Primary Productivity (GPP)
Net Primary Productivity (NPP)
Secondary Productivity
Net Community Respiration
oh: सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (Gross Primary Productivity - GPP)
शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP)
द्वितीयक उत्पादकता (Secondary Productivity)
शुद्ध सामुदायिक श्वसन (Net Community Respiration)
e:
Ecosystem bioenergetics me primary biomass synthesis rate ko gross aur net terms me distinguish kiya jata hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) kisi given area aur time me photosynthetic autotrophs dwara total fixed organic matter/biomass production ki overall gross synthesis rate ko represent karta hai, prior to any respiratory losses.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Net Primary Productivity (NPP) GPP me se plant respiratory losses ($R$) ko subtract karne ke baad bacha net biomass hota hai ($\text{NPP} = \text{GPP} - R$).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because secondary productivity heterotrophic consumers ke biomass generation rate ko designate karti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because community respiration ecosystem ke sabhi organisms dwara consumed respiratory oxygen/energy ko signify karta hai.

qe: Which mathematical equation correctly determines the baseline relationship between Gross Primary Productivity (GPP), Net Primary Productivity (NPP), and Respiration losses (R)?
qh: कौन सा गणितीय समीकरण सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP), शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP), और श्वसन हानि (R) के बीच बुनियादी संबंध को सही ढंग से निर्धारित करता है?
oe: NPP = GPP - R
GPP = NPP - R
R = GPP + NPP
NPP = GPP + R
oh: NPP = GPP - R
GPP = NPP - R
R = GPP + NPP
NPP = GPP + R
e:
Primary productivity balance carbon fixation rate aur autotrophic metabolic expenditure ke arithmetic subtraction par depend karta hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) total synthesized organic biomass hai; plants is total me se ek significant part respiration ($R$) me metabolically consume kar lete hain, isliye heterotrophs ke consumption ke liye available bacha organic balance Net Primary Productivity (NPP) banta hai, perfectly expressed as: $\text{NPP} = \text{GPP} - R$.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because GPP hamesha NPP se bada hota hai ($\text{GPP} = \text{NPP} + R$), isliye subtraction inverted hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Respiration loss GPP aur NPP ka difference hota hai ($R = \text{GPP} - \text{NPP}$), addition nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because NPP gross yield me respiration add karke calculate nahi hota.

qe: In the structural dynamics of energy flow within an ecosystem, the available organic biomass for consumption by heterotrophs (herbivores and decomposers) is directly represented by:
qh: एक पारितंत्र के भीतर ऊर्जा प्रवाह की संरचना में, विषमपोषियों (शाकाहारियों और अपघटकों) द्वारा उपभोग के लिए उपलब्ध जैविक बायोमास को सीधे किसके द्वारा दर्शाया गया है?
oe: Net Primary Productivity (NPP)
Gross Primary Productivity (GPP)
Total Incidental PAR
Respiratory Quotient (RQ)
oh: शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP)
सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP)
कुल आपतित PAR
श्वसन गुणांक (RQ)
e:
Ecosystem bioenergetics me primary producers dwara synthesized biomass ka wo part jo autotrophic respiration ke baad bachta hai, heterotrophic food webs ke liye available rehta hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because Net Primary Productivity (NPP) actual biomass accumulation rate ko represent karta hai jo plants ke metabolic respiration losses ($R$) ke baad bachta hai ($\text{NPP} = \text{GPP} - R$), aur yahi biomass agle trophic levels ke heterotrophs (herbivores, decomposers, aur carnivores) ke consumption ke liye directly available hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) total organic synthesis rate hai jisme se plant respiration deduct hona baki rehta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Incidental PAR solar physical radiation metric hai, assimilated biological organic biomass nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Respiratory Quotient (RQ) metabolic gas exchange ratio ($\text{CO}_2\text{ produced} / \text{O}_2\text{ consumed}$) ko denote karta hai.

qe: Ecosystem dynamics dictate that the movement and transformation of solar energy across consecutive trophic levels behaves in which specific pattern?
qh: पारितंत्र गतिकी (Ecosystem dynamics) यह निर्देशित करती है कि क्रमिक ट्रॉफिक स्तरों पर सौर ऊर्जा का संचलन और रूपांतरण किस विशिष्ट पैटर्न में व्यवहार करता है?
oe: Unidirectional and non-cyclic
Bidirectional and reversible
Multi-directional cyclic loops
Spontaneous uniform accumulation
oh: एकदिशीय और गैर-चक्रीय
द्विदिशीय और प्रतिवर्ती
बहु-दिशात्मक चक्रीय लूप
सहज समान संचय
e:
Trophic energy thermodynamics First aur Second Laws of Thermodynamics ke physical principles par strictly operate karti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because ecosystem me energy flow strictly unidirectional aur non-cyclic hota hai; solar energy primary producers trap karte hain aur wo progressively higher consumers ($T_1 \rightarrow T_2 \rightarrow T_3$) me transfer hoti hai, jahan har stage par respiration ke zariye heat energy dissipate hoti hai aur wo kabhi wapas source ya lower levels par cyclic return nahi kar sakti.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because biological energy transformations reversible ya bidirectional nahi hote.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because multi-directional cyclic loops chemical nutrient cycles (biogeochemical cycles) ka trait hain, energy flow ka nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because trophic levels par energy accumulation uniform nahi hoti balki consecutive levels par drastically decline hoti hai.

qe: Why does a rapidly developing 'Young Forest' show significantly higher primary productivity compared to a 'Natural Old Forest' ecosystem?
qh: एक तेजी से विकसित होने वाला 'युवा वन' (Young Forest) एक 'प्राकृतिक पुराने वन' (Old Forest) पारितंत्र की तुलना में काफी अधिक प्राथमिक उत्पादकता क्यों दर्शाता है?
oe: Young trees grow quicker and have a higher rate of biomass accumulation
Old forests completely lack primary producers
Young forests have lower overall respiration losses ($R = 0$)
Old forests cannot capture photosynthetically active radiation
oh: युवा पेड़ तेजी से बढ़ते हैं और बायोमास संचय की उच्च दर रखते हैं
पुराने जंगलों में प्राथमिक उत्पादकों की पूरी तरह से कमी होती है
युवा जंगलों में समग्र श्वसन हानि कम होती है ($R = 0$)
पुराने जंगल प्रकाश संश्लेषक रूप से सक्रिय विकिरण को ग्रहण नहीं कर सकते हैं
e:
Primary productivity rate of biomass accretion ko signify karti hai jo ecosystem ke successional aur physiological age par heavily depend karti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because rapidly growing young forests active vegetative growth phase me hote hain jahan cell division aur canopy expansion fast hone ke karan carbon fixation aur net biomass accumulation rate significantly high hoti hai; jabki mature old forests climax steady-state achieve kar lete hain jahan respiration costs ($R$) gross production ($P$) ke barabar ho jati hain ($P/R \approx 1$).

• Option 2 is Incorrect because old forests me large mature trees dominant primary producers hote hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because young forests me living cells respiration conduct karti hain ($R > 0$), baseline zero nahi hota.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because old forest canopies efficient PAR absorption capability maintain karti hain.

qe: Which of the following ecosystems is expected to display the lowest primary productivity due to high dead organic matter accumulation and limited active producers?
qh: उच्च मृत कार्बनिक पदार्थ संचय और सीमित सक्रिय उत्पादकों के कारण निम्नलिखित में से किस पारितंत्र में सबसे कम प्राथमिक उत्पादकता प्रदर्शित होने की उम्मीद है?
oe: A shallow polluted lake
A rapidly growing young forest
A tropical deciduous jungle
An alluvial grassland plain
oh: एक उथली प्रदूषित झील
तेजी से बढ़ता युवा जंगल
उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती जंगल
जलोढ़ घास का मैदान
e:
Primary productivity photosynthetic autotrophs ki functional standing crop density aur favorable environmental conditions par depend karti hai.
